1 module eddy_diff

3 !--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4 ! !
5 ! The University of Washington Moist Turbulence Scheme to compute eddy diffusion !
6 ! coefficients associated with dry and moist turbulences in the whole !
7 ! atmospheric layers. !
8 ! !
9 ! For detailed description of the code and its performances, see !
10 ! !
11 ! 1.'A new moist turbulence parametrization in the Community Atmosphere Model' !
12 ! by Christopher S. Bretherton and Sungsu Park. J. Climate. 2009. 22. 3422-3448 !
13 ! 2.'The University of Washington shallow convection and moist turbulence schemes !
14 ! and their impact on climate simulations with the Community Atmosphere Model' !
15 ! by Sungsu Park and Christopher S. Bretherton. J. Climate. 2009. 22. 3449-3469 !
16 ! !
17 ! For questions on the scheme and code, send an email to !
18 ! Sungsu Park at sungsup@ucar.edu (tel: 303-497-1375) !
19 ! Chris Bretherton at breth@washington.edu !
20 ! !
21 ! Developed by Chris Bretherton at the University of Washington, Seattle, WA. !
22 ! Sungsu Park at the CGD/NCAR, Boulder, CO. !
23 ! Last coded on May.2006, Dec.2009 by Sungsu Park. !
24 ! !
25 !--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !

63 real(r8) :: lbulk_max = 40.e3_r8 ! Maximum master length scale designed to address issues in the
64 ! upper atmosphere where vertical model resolution is coarse [ m ].
65 ! In order not to disturb turbulence characteristics in the lower

68 ! atmosphere.
69
70 ! Parameters for 'sedimentation-entrainment feedback' for liquid stratus
71 ! If .false., no sedimentation entrainment feedback ( i.e., use default evhc )
72

76 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
77 ! Parameters governing entrainment efficiency A = a1l(i)*evhc, evhc = 1 + a2l * a3l * L * ql / jt2slv !
78 ! Here, 'ql' is cloud-top LWC and 'jt2slv' is the jump in 'slv' across !
79 ! the cloud-top entrainment zone ( across two grid layers to consider full mixture ) !
80 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
81
82 real(r8), parameter :: a1l = 0.10_r8 ! Dry entrainment efficiency for TKE closure
83 ! a1l = 0.2*tunl*erat^-1.5,
84 ! where erat = <e>/wstar^2 for dry CBL = 0.3.
85
86 real(r8), parameter :: a1i = 0.2_r8 ! Dry entrainment efficiency for wstar closure
87 real(r8), parameter :: ccrit = 0.5_r8 ! Minimum allowable sqrt(tke)/wstar.
88 ! Used in solving cubic equation for 'ebrk'
89 real(r8), parameter :: wstar3factcrit = 0.5_r8 ! 1/wstar3factcrit is the maximally allowed enhancement of
90 ! 'wstar3' due to entrainment.
91
92 real(r8) :: a2l ! Moist entrainment enhancement param (recommended range : 10~30 )
93 real(r8), parameter :: a3l = 0.8_r8 ! Approximation to a complicated thermodynamic parameters
94
95 real(r8), parameter :: jbumin = .001_r8 ! Minimum buoyancy jump at an entrainment jump, [m/s2]
96 real(r8), parameter :: evhcmax = 10._r8 ! Upper limit of evaporative enhancement factor
97
98 real(r8), parameter :: onet = 1._r8/3._r8 ! 1/3 power in wind gradient expression [ no unit ]
99 integer, parameter :: ncvmax = pver ! Max numbers of CLs (good to set to 'pver')
100 real(r8), parameter :: qmin = 1.e-5_r8 ! Minimum grid-mean LWC counted as clouds [kg/kg]
101 real(r8), parameter :: ntzero = 1.e-12_r8 ! Not zero (small positive number used in 's2')
102 real(r8), parameter :: b1 = 5.8_r8 ! TKE dissipation D = e^3/(b1*leng), e = b1*W.
103 real(r8) :: b123 ! b1**(2/3)
104 real(r8), parameter :: tunl = 0.085_r8 ! Asympt leng = tunl*(turb lay depth)
105 real(r8), parameter :: alph1 = 0.5562_r8 ! alph1~alph5 : Galperin instability function parameters
106 real(r8), parameter :: alph2 = -4.3640_r8 ! These coefficients are used to calculate
107 real(r8), parameter :: alph3 = -34.6764_r8 ! 'sh' and 'sm' from 'gh'.
108 real(r8), parameter :: alph4 = -6.1272_r8 !
109 real(r8), parameter :: alph5 = 0.6986_r8 !
110 real(r8), parameter :: ricrit = 0.19_r8 ! Critical Richardson number for turbulence.
111 ! Can be any value >= 0.19.
112 real(r8), parameter :: ae = 1._r8 ! TKE transport efficiency [no unit]
113 real(r8), parameter :: rinc = -0.04_r8 ! Minimum W/<W> used for CL merging test
114 real(r8), parameter :: wpertmin = 1.e-6_r8 ! Minimum PBL eddy vertical velocity perturbation
115 real(r8), parameter :: wfac = 1._r8 ! Ratio of 'wpert' to sqrt(tke) for CL.
116 real(r8), parameter :: tfac = 1._r8 ! Ratio of 'tpert' to (w't')/wpert for CL.
117 ! Same ratio also used for q
118 real(r8), parameter :: fak = 8.5_r8 ! Constant in surface temperature excess for stable STL.
119 ! [ no unit ]
120 real(r8), parameter :: rcapmin = 0.1_r8 ! Minimum allowable e/<e> in a CL
121 real(r8), parameter :: rcapmax = 2.0_r8 ! Maximum allowable e/<e> in a CL
122 real(r8), parameter :: tkemax = 20._r8 ! TKE is capped at tkemax [m2/s2]
123 real(r8), parameter :: lambda = 0.5_r8 ! Under-relaxation factor ( 0 < lambda =< 1 )
124
125 logical, parameter :: use_kvf = .false. ! .true. (.false.) : initialize kvh/kvm = kvf ( 0. )
126 logical, parameter :: use_dw_surf = .true. ! Used in 'zisocl'. Default is 'true'
127 ! If 'true', surface interfacial energy does not contribute
128 ! to the CL mean stability functions after finishing merging.
129 ! For this case, 'dl2n2_surf' is only used for a merging test

131 ! If 'false',surface interfacial enery explicitly contribute to

134 ! for calculating surface interfacial layer energetics
135
136 logical, parameter :: set_qrlzero = .false. ! .true. ( .false.) : turning-off ( on) radiative-turbulence

35152224104448 subroutine compute_eddy_diff( lchnk , &
352 pcols , pver , ncol , t , qv , ztodt , &
353 ql , qi , s , pdel, rpdel , cldn , qrl , wsedl , &
354 z , zi , pmid , pi , u , v , &
355 taux , tauy , shflx , qflx , wstarent , nturb , rrho , &
356 ustar , pblh , kvm_in , kvh_in , kvm_out , kvh_out , kvq , &
357 cgh , cgs , tpert , qpert , wpert , tke , bprod , &
358 sprod , sfi , kvinit , &
359 tauresx, tauresy, ksrftms , &
360 ipbl , kpblh , wstarPBL , tkes , went ,turbtype, sm_aw )
361
362 !-------------------------------------------------------------------- !
363 ! Purpose: Interface to compute eddy diffusivities. !
364 ! Eddy diffusivities are calculated in a fully implicit way !
365 ! through iteration process. !
366 ! Author: Sungsu Park. August. 2006. !
367 ! May. 2008. !
368 !-------------------------------------------------------------------- !
369
370 use diffusion_solver, only: compute_vdiff

404 real(r8), intent(in) :: cldn(pcols,pver) ! Stratiform cloud fraction [ fraction ]

406 real(r8), intent(in) :: wsedl(pcols,pver) ! Sedimentation velocity of liquid stratus cloud droplet [ m/s ]

469208896261120 real(r8) :: kvh(pcols,pver+1) ! Eddy diffusivity for heat [ m2/s ]

479 real(r8) :: pblhp(pcols) ! PBL top pressure [ Pa ]

481
482 real(r8) :: qt(pcols,pver) ! Total specific humidity [ kg/kg ]

484 real(r8) :: sflh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in lower half-layer [ fraction ]
485 real(r8) :: sl(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water static energy [ J/kg ]
486 real(r8) :: slv(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water virtual static energy [ J/kg ]
487 real(r8) :: slslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'sl' in each layer

489 real(r8) :: qvfd(pcols,pver) ! Specific humidity for diffusion [ kg/kg ]
490 real(r8) :: tfd(pcols,pver) ! Temperature for diffusion [ K ]
491 real(r8) :: slfd(pcols,pver) ! Liquid static energy [ J/kg ]
492 real(r8) :: qtfd(pcols,pver) ! Total specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
493 real(r8) :: qlfd(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water specific humidity for diffusion [ kg/kg ]
494 real(r8) :: ufd(pcols,pver) ! U-wind for diffusion [ m/s ]
495 real(r8) :: vfd(pcols,pver) ! V-wind for diffusion [ m/s ]
496

498
499 real(r8) :: chu(pcols,pver+1) ! Heat buoyancy coef for dry states, defined at each interface, finally.
500 real(r8) :: chs(pcols,pver+1) ! Heat buoyancy coef for sat states, defined at each interface, finally.
501 real(r8) :: cmu(pcols,pver+1) ! Moisture buoyancy coef for dry states,
502 ! defined at each interface, finally.
503 real(r8) :: cms(pcols,pver+1) ! Moisture buoyancy coef for sat states,
504 ! defined at each interface, finally.
505
506 real(r8) :: jnk1d(pcols)
507 real(r8) :: jnk2d(pcols,pver+1)
508 real(r8) :: zero(pcols)
5095222452224 real(r8) :: zero2d(pcols,pver+1)
510 real(r8) :: es ! Saturation vapor pressure
511 real(r8) :: qs ! Saturation specific humidity
512 real(r8) :: ep2, templ, temps

515 ! Variables for diagnostic output !

517
518 real(r8) :: kbase_o(pcols,ncvmax) ! Original external base interface index of CL from 'exacol'
519 real(r8) :: ktop_o(pcols,ncvmax) ! Original external top interface index of CL from 'exacol'
520 real(r8) :: ncvfin_o(pcols) ! Original number of CLs from 'exacol'
521 real(r8) :: kbase_mg(pcols,ncvmax) ! 'kbase' after extending-merging from 'zisocl'
522 real(r8) :: ktop_mg(pcols,ncvmax) ! 'ktop' after extending-merging from 'zisocl'
523 real(r8) :: ncvfin_mg(pcols) ! 'ncvfin' after extending-merging from 'zisocl'
524 real(r8) :: kbase_f(pcols,ncvmax) ! Final 'kbase' after extending-merging & including SRCL
525 real(r8) :: ktop_f(pcols,ncvmax) ! Final 'ktop' after extending-merging & including SRCL
526 real(r8) :: ncvfin_f(pcols) ! Final 'ncvfin' after extending-merging & including SRCL
527 real(r8) :: wet(pcols,ncvmax) ! Entrainment rate at the CL top [ m/s ]
528 real(r8) :: web(pcols,ncvmax) ! Entrainment rate at the CL base [ m/s ].
529 ! Set to zero if CL is based at surface.
530 real(r8) :: jtbu(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy jump across the CL top [ m/s2 ]
531 real(r8) :: jbbu(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy jump across the CL base [ m/s2 ]
532 real(r8) :: evhc(pcols,ncvmax) ! Evaporative enhancement factor at the CL top
533 real(r8) :: jt2slv(pcols,ncvmax) ! Jump of slv ( across two layers ) at CL top used only for evhc [ J/kg ]
534 real(r8) :: n2ht(pcols,ncvmax) ! n2 defined at the CL top interface but using
535 ! sfuh(kt) instead of sfi(kt) [ s-2 ]
536 real(r8) :: n2hb(pcols,ncvmax) ! n2 defined at the CL base interface but using
537 ! sflh(kb-1) instead of sfi(kb) [ s-2 ]
538 real(r8) :: lwp(pcols,ncvmax) ! LWP in the CL top layer [ kg/m2 ]
539 real(r8) :: opt_depth(pcols,ncvmax) ! Optical depth of the CL top layer
540 real(r8) :: radinvfrac(pcols,ncvmax) ! Fraction of radiative cooling confined in the top portion of CL top layer
541 real(r8) :: radf(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy production at the CL top due to LW radiative cooling [ m2/s3 ]
542 real(r8) :: wstar(pcols,ncvmax) ! Convective velocity in each CL [ m/s ]
543 real(r8) :: wstar3fact(pcols,ncvmax) ! Enhancement of 'wstar3' due to entrainment (inverse) [ no unit ]
544 real(r8) :: ebrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Net mean TKE of CL including entrainment effect [ m2/s2 ]
545 real(r8) :: wbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Net mean normalized TKE (W) of CL,
546 ! 'ebrk/b1' including entrainment effect [ m2/s2 ]
547 real(r8) :: lbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Energetic internal thickness of CL [m]
548 real(r8) :: ricl(pcols,ncvmax) ! CL internal mean Richardson number
549 real(r8) :: ghcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Half of normalized buoyancy production of CL
550 real(r8) :: shcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Galperin instability function of heat-moisture of CL
551 real(r8) :: smcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Galperin instability function of mementum of CL
552 real(r8) :: ghi(pcols,pver+1) ! Half of normalized buoyancy production at all interfaces
553 real(r8) :: shi(pcols,pver+1) ! Galperin instability function of heat-moisture at all interfaces
554 real(r8) :: smi(pcols,pver+1) ! Galperin instability function of heat-moisture at all interfaces
555 real(r8) :: rii(pcols,pver+1) ! Interfacial Richardson number defined at all interfaces
556 real(r8) :: lengi(pcols,pver+1) ! Turbulence length scale at all interfaces [ m ]
557 real(r8) :: wcap(pcols,pver+1) ! Normalized TKE at all interfaces [ m2/s2 ]
558 real(r8) :: rairi(pcols,pver+1) ! interface gas constant needed for compute_vdiff
559 ! For sedimentation-entrainment feedback
560 real(r8) :: wsed(pcols,ncvmax) ! Sedimentation velocity at the top of each CL [ m/s ]
561
562 ! ---------- !
563 ! Initialize !
564 ! ---------- !
565
566835584940032 zero(:) = 0._r8
5672590310430812160 zero2d(:,:) = 0._r8
568
569 ! ----------------------- !
570 ! Main Computation Begins !
571 ! ----------------------- !
572
5732115378025958388 ufd(:ncol,:) = u(:ncol,:)
5742115378025958388 vfd(:ncol,:) = v(:ncol,:)
5752115378025958388 tfd(:ncol,:) = t(:ncol,:)
5762115378025958388 qvfd(:ncol,:) = qv(:ncol,:)
5772115378025958388 qlfd(:ncol,:) = ql(:ncol,:)
578
579261120313344 do iturb = 1, nturb
580
581 ! Total stress includes 'tms'.
582 ! Here, in computing 'tms', we can use either iteratively changed 'ufd,vfd' or the
583 ! initially given 'u,v' to the PBL scheme. Note that normal stress, 'taux, tauy'
584 ! are not changed by iteration. In order to treat 'tms' in a fully implicit way,
585 ! I am using updated wind, here.
586
587 ! Compute ustar
58835256307573500 call calc_ustar( tfd(:ncol,pver), pmid(:ncol,pver), &
589 taux(:ncol) - ksrftms(:ncol) * ufd(:ncol,pver), & ! Zonal wind stress
590 tauy(:ncol) - ksrftms(:ncol) * vfd(:ncol,pver), & ! Meridional wind stress
591 rrho(:ncol), ustar(:ncol))
59235256304047870 minpblh(:ncol) = 100.0_r8 * ustar(:ncol) ! By construction, 'minpblh' is larger than 1 [m] when 'ustar_min = 0.01'.
593
594 ! Calculate (qt,sl,n2,s2,ri) from a given set of (t,qv,ql,qi,u,v)
595
596261120261120 call trbintd( &
597 pcols , pver , ncol , z , ufd , vfd , tfd , pmid , &
598 s2 , n2 , ri , zi , pi , cldn , qtfd , qvfd , &
599 qlfd , qi , sfi , sfuh , sflh , slfd , slv , slslope , &
600 qtslope , chs , chu , cms , cmu )
601
602 ! Save initial (i.e., before iterative diffusion) profile of (qt,sl) at each iteration.
603 ! Only necessary for (qt,sl) not (u,v) because (qt,sl) are newly calculated variables.
604
605261120261120 if( iturb .eq. 1 ) then
6062115378025958388 qt(:ncol,:) = qtfd(:ncol,:)
6072115378025958388 sl(:ncol,:) = slfd(:ncol,:)
608 endif
609
610 ! Get free atmosphere exchange coefficients. This 'kvf' is not used in UW moist PBL scheme
611
612261120261120 call austausch_atm( pcols, pver, ncol, ri, s2, kvf )
613
614 ! Initialize kvh/kvm to send to caleddy, depending on model timestep and iteration number
615 ! This is necessary for 'wstar-based' entrainment closure.
616
617261120261120 if( iturb .eq. 1 ) then
6185222452224 if( kvinit ) then
619 ! First iteration of first model timestep : Use free tropospheric value or zero.
62010241024 if( use_kvf ) then
62100 kvh(:ncol,:) = kvf(:ncol,:)
62200 kvm(:ncol,:) = kvf(:ncol,:)
623 else
624428606524862 kvh(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
625428606524862 kvm(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
626 endif
627 else
628 ! First iteration on any model timestep except the first : Use value from previous timestep
6292143030026243100 kvh(:ncol,:) = kvh_in(:ncol,:)
6302143030026243100 kvm(:ncol,:) = kvm_in(:ncol,:)
631 endif
632 else
633 ! Not the first iteration : Use from previous iteration
63487435624107071848 kvh(:ncol,:) = kvh_out(:ncol,:)
63587435624107071848 kvm(:ncol,:) = kvm_out(:ncol,:)
636 endif
637
638 ! Calculate eddy diffusivity (kvh_out,kvm_out) and (tke,bprod,sprod) using
639 ! a given (kvh,kvm) which are used only for initializing (bprod,sprod) at
640 ! the first part of caleddy. (bprod,sprod) are fully updated at the end of
641 ! caleddy after calculating (kvh_out,kvm_out)
642
643261120261120 call caleddy( pcols , pver , ncol , &
644 slfd , qtfd , qlfd , slv ,ufd , &
645 vfd , pi , z , zi , &
646 qflx , shflx , slslope , qtslope , &
647 chu , chs , cmu , cms ,sfuh , &
648 sflh , n2 , s2 , ri ,rrho , &
649 pblh , ustar , &
650 kvh , kvm , kvh_out , kvm_out , &
651 tpert , qpert , qrl , kvf , tke , &
652 wstarent , bprod , sprod , minpblh , wpert , &
653 tkes , went , turbtype , sm_aw , &
654 kbase_o , ktop_o , ncvfin_o , &
655 kbase_mg , ktop_mg , ncvfin_mg , &
656 kbase_f , ktop_f , ncvfin_f , &
657 wet , web , jtbu , jbbu , &
658 evhc , jt2slv , n2ht , n2hb , &
659 lwp , opt_depth , radinvfrac, radf , &
660 wstar , wstar3fact, &
661 ebrk , wbrk , lbrk , ricl , ghcl , &
662 shcl , smcl , ghi , shi , smi , &
663 rii , lengi , wcap , pblhp , cldn , &
664 ipbl , kpblh , wsedl , wsed)
665
666 ! Calculate errorPBL to check whether PBL produced convergent solutions or not.
667
668261120261120 if( iturb .eq. nturb ) then
669705126757350 do i = 1, ncol
670705126705126 errorPBL(i) = 0._r8
6712115378021153780 do k = 1, pver
672 errorPBL(i) = errorPBL(i) + ( kvh(i,k) - kvh_out(i,k) )**2
673 end do
674 errorPBL(i) = sqrt(errorPBL(i)/pver)
675 end do
676 end if
677
678 ! Eddy diffusivities which will be used for the initialization of (bprod,
679 ! sprod) in 'caleddy' at the next iteration step.
680
681261120470016 if( iturb .gt. 1 .and. iturb .lt. nturb ) then
6826557671880303886 kvm_out(:ncol,:) = lambda * kvm_out(:ncol,:) + ( 1._r8 - lambda ) * kvm(:ncol,:)
6836557671880303886 kvh_out(:ncol,:) = lambda * kvh_out(:ncol,:) + ( 1._r8 - lambda ) * kvh(:ncol,:)
684 endif
685
686 ! Set nonlocal terms to zero for flux diagnostics, since not used by caleddy.
687
688109294530133839810 cgh(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
689109294530133839810 cgs(:ncol,:) = 0._r8
690
691261120261120 if( iturb .lt. nturb ) then
692
693 ! Each time we diffuse the original state
694
69584615120103833552 slfd(:ncol,:) = sl(:ncol,:)
69684615120103833552 qtfd(:ncol,:) = qt(:ncol,:)
69784615120103833552 ufd(:ncol,:) = u(:ncol,:)
69884615120103833552 vfd(:ncol,:) = v(:ncol,:)
699
700 !------------------------------------------------------------------------
701 ! Check to see if constituent dependent gas constant needed (WACCM-X)
702 !------------------------------------------------------------------------
703208896626688 if ( waccmx_is('ionosphere') .or. waccmx_is('neutral') ) then
70400 rairi(:ncol,1) = rairv(:ncol,1,lchnk)
70500 do k = 2, pver
70600 do i = 1, ncol
707 rairi(i,k) = 0.5_r8 * (rairv(i,k,lchnk)+rairv(i,k-1,lchnk))
708 end do
709 end do
710 else
71187435624107280744 rairi(:ncol,:pver+1) = rair
712 endif
713
714 ! Diffuse initial profile of each time step using a given (kvh_out,kvm_out)
715 ! In the below 'compute_vdiff', (slfd,qtfd,ufd,vfd) are 'inout' variables.
716
7172088961462272 call compute_vdiff( lchnk , &
718 pcols , pver , 1 , ncol , pmid , &
719 pi , pdel, rpdel , t , ztodt , taux , &
720 tauy , shflx , qflx , ntop_turb , nbot_turb , &
721 kvh_out , kvm_out , kvh_out , cgs , cgh , &
722 zi , ksrftms , zero , fieldlist_wet, fieldlist_molec, &
723 ufd , vfd , qtfd , slfd , &
724 jnk1d , jnk1d , jnk2d , jnk1d , errstring , &
725 tauresx , tauresy , 0 , cpairv(:,:,lchnk), rairi , .false. )
726
727208896208896 call handle_errmsg(errstring, subname="compute_vdiff", &
728 extra_msg="compute_vdiff called from eddy_diff")
729
730 ! Retrieve (tfd,qvfd,qlfd) from (slfd,qtfd) in order to
731 ! use 'trbintd' at the next iteration.
732
73362668806475776 do k = 1, pver
7348461512090882000 do i = 1, ncol
735 ! ----------------------------------------------------- !
736 ! Compute the condensate 'qlfd' in the updated profiles !
737 ! ----------------------------------------------------- !
738 ! Option.1 : Assume grid-mean condensate is homogeneously diffused by the moist turbulence scheme.
739 ! This should bs used if 'pseudodiff = .false.' in vertical_diffusion.F90.
740 ! Modification : Need to be check whether below is correct in the presence of ice, qi.
741 ! I should understand why the variation of ice, qi is neglected during diffusion.
7428461512084615120 templ = ( slfd(i,k) - g*z(i,k) ) / cpair
7438461512084615120 call qsat( templ, pmid(i,k), es, qs)
7448461512084615120 ep2 = .622_r8
745 temps = templ + ( qtfd(i,k) - qs ) / ( cpair / latvap + latvap * qs / ( rair * templ**2 ) )
7468461512084615120 call qsat( temps, pmid(i,k), es, qs)
747 qlfd(i,k) = max( qtfd(i,k) - qi(i,k) - qs ,0._r8 )
748 ! Option.2 : Assume condensate is not diffused by the moist turbulence scheme.
749 ! This should bs used if 'pseudodiff = .true.' in vertical_diffusion.F90.
750 ! qlfd(i,k) = ql(i,k)
751 ! ----------------------------- !
752 ! Compute the other 'qvfd, tfd' !
753 ! ----------------------------- !
754 qvfd(i,k) = max( 0._r8, qtfd(i,k) - qi(i,k) - qlfd(i,k) )
755 tfd(i,k) = ( slfd(i,k) + latvap * qlfd(i,k) + latsub * qi(i,k) - g*z(i,k)) / cpair
756 end do
757 end do
758 endif
759
760 ! Debug
761 ! icol = phys_debug_col(lchnk)
762 ! if( icol > 0 .and. get_nstep() .ge. 1 ) then
763 ! write(iulog,*) ' '
764 ! write(iulog,*) 'eddy_diff debug at the end of iteration'
765 ! write(iulog,*) 't, qv, ql, cld, u, v'
766 ! do k = pver-3, pver
767 ! write (iulog,*) k, tfd(icol,k), qvfd(icol,k), qlfd(icol,k), cldn(icol,k), ufd(icol,k), vfd(icol,k)
768 ! end do
769 ! endif
770 ! Debug
771
772 end do ! End of 'iturb' iteration
773
7742185890626767962 kvq(:ncol,:) = kvh_out(:ncol,:)
775
776 ! Compute 'wstar' within the PBL for use in the future convection scheme.
777
778705126757350 do i = 1, ncol
779705126705126 if(ipbl(i) .eq. 1) then
780533461533461 wstarPBL(i) = max( 0._r8, wstar(i,1) )
781 else
782171665171665 wstarPBL(i) = 0._r8
783 endif
784 end do
785
786 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
787 ! Writing for detailed diagnostic analysis of UW moist PBL scheme !
788 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
789
7905222452224 call outfld( 'UW_errorPBL', errorPBL, pcols, lchnk )
791
7925222452224 call outfld( 'UW_n2', n2, pcols, lchnk )
7935222452224 call outfld( 'UW_s2', s2, pcols, lchnk )
7945222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ri', ri, pcols, lchnk )
795
7965222452224 call outfld( 'UW_sfuh', sfuh, pcols, lchnk )
7975222452224 call outfld( 'UW_sflh', sflh, pcols, lchnk )
7985222452224 call outfld( 'UW_sfi', sfi, pcols, lchnk )
799
8005222452224 call outfld( 'UW_cldn', cldn, pcols, lchnk )
8015222452224 call outfld( 'UW_qrl', qrl, pcols, lchnk )
8025222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ql', qlfd, pcols, lchnk )
803
8045222452224 call outfld( 'UW_chu', chu, pcols, lchnk )
8055222452224 call outfld( 'UW_chs', chs, pcols, lchnk )
8065222452224 call outfld( 'UW_cmu', cmu, pcols, lchnk )
8075222452224 call outfld( 'UW_cms', cms, pcols, lchnk )
808
8095222452224 call outfld( 'UW_tke', tke, pcols, lchnk )
8105222452224 call outfld( 'UW_wcap', wcap, pcols, lchnk )
8115222452224 call outfld( 'UW_bprod', bprod, pcols, lchnk )
8125222452224 call outfld( 'UW_sprod', sprod, pcols, lchnk )
813
8145222452224 call outfld( 'UW_kvh', kvh_out, pcols, lchnk )
8155222452224 call outfld( 'UW_kvm', kvm_out, pcols, lchnk )
816
8175222452224 call outfld( 'UW_pblh', pblh, pcols, lchnk )
8185222452224 call outfld( 'UW_pblhp', pblhp, pcols, lchnk )
8195222452224 call outfld( 'UW_tpert', tpert, pcols, lchnk )
8205222452224 call outfld( 'UW_qpert', qpert, pcols, lchnk )
8215222452224 call outfld( 'UW_wpert', wpert, pcols, lchnk )
822
8235222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ustar', ustar, pcols, lchnk )
8245222452224 call outfld( 'UW_tkes', tkes, pcols, lchnk )
8255222452224 call outfld( 'UW_minpblh', minpblh, pcols, lchnk )
826
8272590310430968832 call outfld( 'UW_turbtype', real(turbtype,r8), pcols, lchnk )
828
8295222452224 call outfld( 'UW_kbase_o', kbase_o, pcols, lchnk )
8305222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ktop_o', ktop_o, pcols, lchnk )
8315222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ncvfin_o', ncvfin_o, pcols, lchnk )
832
8335222452224 call outfld( 'UW_kbase_mg', kbase_mg, pcols, lchnk )
8345222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ktop_mg', ktop_mg, pcols, lchnk )

836

8385222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ktop_f', ktop_f, pcols, lchnk )
8395222452224 call outfld( 'UW_ncvfin_f', ncvfin_f, pcols, lchnk )

8415222452224 call outfld( 'UW_wet', wet, pcols, lchnk )
8425222452224 call outfld( 'UW_web', web, pcols, lchnk )

878
879261120522240 subroutine sfdiag( pcols , pver , ncol , qt , ql , sl , &
880 pi , pm , zi , cld , sfi , sfuh , &
881 sflh , slslope , qtslope )
882 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
883 ! !
884 ! Purpose: Interface for calculating saturation fractions at upper and !
885 ! lower-half layers, & interfaces for use by turbulence scheme !
886 ! !
887 ! Method : Various but 'l' should be chosen for consistency. !
888 ! !
889 ! Author : B. Stevens and C. Bretherton (August 2000) !
890 ! Sungsu Park. August 2006. !
891 ! May. 2008. !
892 ! !
893 ! S.Park : The computed saturation fractions are repeatedly !
894 ! used to compute buoyancy coefficients in'trbintd' & 'caleddy'.!
895 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
896
897 implicit none
898
899 ! --------------- !
900 ! Input arguments !
901 ! --------------- !
902
903 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
904 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric layers
905 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of atmospheric columns
906
907 real(r8), intent(in) :: sl(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water static energy [ J/kg ]
908 real(r8), intent(in) :: qt(pcols,pver) ! Total water specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
909 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
910 real(r8), intent(in) :: pi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface pressures [ Pa ]
911 real(r8), intent(in) :: pm(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point pressures [ Pa ]
912 real(r8), intent(in) :: zi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface heights [ m ]
913 real(r8), intent(in) :: cld(pcols,pver) ! Stratiform cloud fraction [ fraction ]
914 real(r8), intent(in) :: slslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'sl' in each layer
915 real(r8), intent(in) :: qtslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'qt' in each layer
916
917 ! ---------------- !
918 ! Output arguments !
919 ! ---------------- !
920
921261120261120 real(r8), intent(out) :: sfi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interfacial layer saturation fraction [ fraction ]
922 real(r8), intent(out) :: sfuh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in upper half-layer [ fraction ]
923 real(r8), intent(out) :: sflh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in lower half-layer [ fraction ]
924
925 ! --------------- !
926 ! Local Variables !
927 ! --------------- !
928
929 integer :: i ! Longitude index
930 integer :: k ! Vertical index
931 integer :: km1 ! k-1
932 integer :: status ! Status returned by function calls
933 real(r8) :: sltop, slbot ! sl at top/bot of grid layer
934 real(r8) :: qttop, qtbot ! qt at top/bot of grid layer
935 real(r8) :: tltop, tlbot ! Liquid water temperature at top/bot of grid layer
936 real(r8) :: qxtop, qxbot ! Sat excess at top/bot of grid layer
937 real(r8) :: qxm ! Sat excess at midpoint
938 real(r8) :: es ! Saturation vapor pressure
939 real(r8) :: qs ! Saturation spec. humidity
940 real(r8) :: cldeff(pcols,pver) ! Effective Cloud Fraction [ fraction ]
941
942 ! ----------------------- !
943 ! Main Computation Begins !
944 ! ----------------------- !
945
946109294530133839810 sfi(1:ncol,:) = 0._r8
947105768900129791940 sfuh(1:ncol,:) = 0._r8
948105768900129791940 sflh(1:ncol,:) = 0._r8
949105768900129791940 cldeff(1:ncol,:) = 0._r8
950
951261120261120 select case (sftype)
952 case ('d')
953 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
954 ! Simply use the given stratus fraction ('horizontal' cloud partitioning) !
955 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
95600 do k = ntop_turb + 1, nbot_turb
95700 km1 = k - 1
95800 do i = 1, ncol
959 sfuh(i,k) = cld(i,k)
960 sflh(i,k) = cld(i,k)
961 sfi(i,k) = 0.5_r8 * ( sflh(i,km1) + min( sflh(i,km1), sfuh(i,k) ) )
962 end do
963 end do
96400 do i = 1, ncol
965 sfi(i,pver+1) = sflh(i,pver)
966 end do
967 case ('l')
968 ! ------------------------------------------ !
969 ! Use modified stratus fraction partitioning !
970 ! ------------------------------------------ !
97175724807833600 do k = ntop_turb + 1, nbot_turb
97275724807572480 km1 = k - 1
973102243270102243270 do i = 1, ncol
974102243270102243270 cldeff(i,k) = cld(i,k)
975 sfuh(i,k) = cld(i,k)
976 sflh(i,k) = cld(i,k)
977 if( ql(i,k) .lt. qmin ) then
9789686714596867145 sfuh(i,k) = 0._r8
979 sflh(i,k) = 0._r8
980 end if
981 ! Modification : The contribution of ice should be carefully considered.
982102243270306729810 if( choice_evhc .eq. 'ramp' .or. choice_radf .eq. 'ramp' ) then
98300 cldeff(i,k) = cld(i,k) * min( ql(i,k) / qmin, 1._r8 )
984 sfuh(i,k) = cldeff(i,k)
985 sflh(i,k) = cldeff(i,k)
986102243270204486540 elseif( choice_evhc .eq. 'maxi' .or. choice_radf .eq. 'maxi' ) then
987102243270102243270 cldeff(i,k) = cld(i,k)
988 sfuh(i,k) = cldeff(i,k)
989 sflh(i,k) = cldeff(i,k)
990 endif
991 ! At the stratus top, take the minimum interfacial saturation fraction
992 sfi(i,k) = 0.5_r8 * ( sflh(i,km1) + min( sfuh(i,k), sflh(i,km1) ) )
993 ! Modification : Currently sfi at the top and surface interfaces are set to be zero.
994 ! Also, sfuh and sflh in the top model layer is set to be zero.
995 ! However, I may need to set
996 ! do i = 1, ncol
997 ! sfi(i,pver+1) = sflh(i,pver)
998 ! end do
999 ! for treating surface-based fog.
1000 ! OK. I added below block similar to the other cases.
1001 end do
1002 end do
100335256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1004 sfi(i,pver+1) = sflh(i,pver)
1005 end do
1006 case ('u')
1007 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1008 ! Use unsaturated buoyancy - since sfi, sfuh, sflh have already been zeroed !
1009 ! nothing more need be done for this case. !
1010 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1011 case ('z')
1012 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1013 ! Calculate saturation fraction based on whether the air just above or just !
1014 ! below the interface is saturated, i.e. with vertical cloud partitioning. !
1015 ! The saturation fraction of the interfacial layer between mid-points k and !
1016 ! k+1 is computed by averaging the saturation fraction of the half-layers !
1017 ! above and below the interface, with a special provision for cloud tops !
1018 ! (more cloud in the half-layer below than in the half-layer above).In each !
1019 ! half-layer, vertical partitioning of cloud based on the slopes diagnosed !
1020 ! above is used. Loop down through the layers, computing the saturation !
1021 ! fraction in each half-layer (sfuh for upper half, sflh for lower half). !
1022 ! Once sfuh(i,k) is computed, use with sflh(i,k-1) to determine saturation !
1023 ! fraction sfi(i,k) for interfacial layer k-0.5. !
1024 ! This is 'not' chosen for full consistent treatment of stratus fraction in !
1025 ! all physics schemes. !
1026 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
102700 do k = ntop_turb + 1, nbot_turb
102800 km1 = k - 1
102900 do i = 1, ncol
1030 ! Compute saturation excess at the mid-point of layer k
103100 sltop = sl(i,k) + slslope(i,k) * ( pi(i,k) - pm(i,k) )
1032 qttop = qt(i,k) + qtslope(i,k) * ( pi(i,k) - pm(i,k) )
1033 tltop = ( sltop - g * zi(i,k) ) / cpair
103400 call qsat( tltop, pi(i,k), es, qs)
103500 qxtop = qttop - qs
1036 slbot = sl(i,k) + slslope(i,k) * ( pi(i,k+1) - pm(i,k) )
1037 qtbot = qt(i,k) + qtslope(i,k) * ( pi(i,k+1) - pm(i,k) )
1038 tlbot = ( slbot - g * zi(i,k+1) ) / cpair
103900 call qsat( tlbot, pi(i,k+1), es, qs)
104000 qxbot = qtbot - qs
1041 qxm = qxtop + ( qxbot - qxtop ) * ( pm(i,k) - pi(i,k) ) / ( pi(i,k+1) - pi(i,k) )
1042 ! Find the saturation fraction sfuh(i,k) of the upper half of layer k.
104300 if( ( qxtop .lt. 0._r8 ) .and. ( qxm .lt. 0._r8 ) ) then
104400 sfuh(i,k) = 0._r8
104500 else if( ( qxtop .gt. 0._r8 ) .and. ( qxm .gt. 0._r8 ) ) then
104600 sfuh(i,k) = 1._r8
1047 else ! Either qxm < 0 and qxtop > 0 or vice versa
104800 sfuh(i,k) = max( qxtop, qxm ) / abs( qxtop - qxm )
1049 end if
1050 ! Combine with sflh(i) (still for layer k-1) to get interfac layer saturation fraction
105100 sfi(i,k) = 0.5_r8 * ( sflh(i,k-1) + min( sflh(i,k-1), sfuh(i,k) ) )
1052 ! Update sflh to be for the lower half of layer k.
105300 if( ( qxbot .lt. 0._r8 ) .and. ( qxm .lt. 0._r8 ) ) then
105400 sflh(i,k) = 0._r8
105500 else if( ( qxbot .gt. 0._r8 ) .and. ( qxm .gt. 0._r8 ) ) then
105600 sflh(i,k) = 1._r8
1057 else ! Either qxm < 0 and qxbot > 0 or vice versa
105800 sflh(i,k) = max( qxbot, qxm ) / abs( qxbot - qxm )
1059 end if
1060 end do ! i
1061 end do ! k
106200 do i = 1, ncol
1063 sfi(i,pver+1) = sflh(i,pver) ! Saturation fraction in the lowest half-layer.
1064 end do
1065 end select
1066
1067 return
1068 end subroutine sfdiag
1069
1070 !=============================================================================== !
1071 ! !
1072 !=============================================================================== !
1073
1074261120522240 subroutine trbintd( pcols , pver , ncol , &
1075 z , u , v , &
1076 t , pmid , &
1077 s2 , n2 , ri , &
1078 zi , pi , cld , &
1079 qt , qv , ql , qi , sfi , sfuh , &
1080 sflh , sl , slv , slslope , qtslope , &
1081 chs , chu , cms , cmu )
1082 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1083 ! Purpose: Calculate buoyancy coefficients at all interfaces including !
1084 ! surface. Also, computes the profiles of ( sl,qt,n2,s2,ri ). !
1085 ! Note that (n2,s2,ri) are defined at each interfaces except !
1086 ! surface. !
1087 ! !
1088 ! Author: B. Stevens ( Extracted from pbldiff, August, 2000 ) !
1089 ! Sungsu Park ( August 2006, May. 2008 ) !
1090 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1091
1092 implicit none
1093
1094 ! --------------- !
1095 ! Input arguments !
1096 ! --------------- !
1097
1098 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
1099 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric layers
1100 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of atmospheric columns
1101 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point height above surface [ m ]
1102 real(r8), intent(in) :: u(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point u [ m/s ]
1103 real(r8), intent(in) :: v(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point v [ m/s ]
1104 real(r8), intent(in) :: t(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point temperature [ K ]
1105 real(r8), intent(in) :: pmid(pcols,pver) ! Layer mid-point pressure [ Pa ]
1106 real(r8), intent(in) :: zi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface height [ m ]
1107 real(r8), intent(in) :: pi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface pressure [ Pa ]
1108 real(r8), intent(in) :: cld(pcols,pver) ! Stratus fraction
1109 real(r8), intent(in) :: qv(pcols,pver) ! Water vapor specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
1110 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
1111 real(r8), intent(in) :: qi(pcols,pver) ! Ice water specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
1112
1113 ! ---------------- !
1114 ! Output arguments !
1115 ! ---------------- !
1116
1117 real(r8), intent(out) :: s2(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial ( except surface ) shear squared [ s-2 ]
1118 real(r8), intent(out) :: n2(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial ( except surface ) buoyancy frequency [ s-2 ]
1119 real(r8), intent(out) :: ri(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial ( except surface ) Richardson number, 'n2/s2'
1120
1121 real(r8), intent(out) :: qt(pcols,pver) ! Total specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
1122 real(r8), intent(out) :: sfi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interfacial layer saturation fraction [ fraction ]
1123 real(r8), intent(out) :: sfuh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in upper half-layer [ fraction ]
1124 real(r8), intent(out) :: sflh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in lower half-layer [ fraction ]
1125 real(r8), intent(out) :: sl(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water static energy [ J/kg ]
1126 real(r8), intent(out) :: slv(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water virtual static energy [ J/kg ]
1127
1128 real(r8), intent(out) :: chu(pcols,pver+1) ! Heat buoyancy coef for dry states at all interfaces, finally.
1129 ! [ unit ? ]
1130 real(r8), intent(out) :: chs(pcols,pver+1) ! heat buoyancy coef for sat states at all interfaces, finally.
1131 ! [ unit ? ]
1132 real(r8), intent(out) :: cmu(pcols,pver+1) ! Moisture buoyancy coef for dry states at all interfaces, finally.
1133 ! [ unit ? ]
1134 real(r8), intent(out) :: cms(pcols,pver+1) ! Moisture buoyancy coef for sat states at all interfaces, finally.
1135 ! [ unit ? ]
1136 real(r8), intent(out) :: slslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'sl' in each layer
1137 real(r8), intent(out) :: qtslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'qt' in each layer
1138
1139 ! --------------- !
1140 ! Local Variables !
1141 ! --------------- !
1142
1143 integer :: i ! Longitude index
1144 integer :: k, km1 ! Level index
1145 integer :: status ! Status returned by function calls
1146
1147 real(r8) :: qs(pcols,pver) ! Saturation specific humidity
1148 real(r8) :: es(pcols,pver) ! Saturation vapor pressure
1149 real(r8) :: gam(pcols,pver) ! (l/cp)*(d(qs)/dT)
1150 real(r8) :: rdz ! 1 / (delta z) between midpoints
1151 real(r8) :: dsldz ! 'delta sl / delta z' at interface
1152 real(r8) :: dqtdz ! 'delta qt / delta z' at interface
1153 real(r8) :: ch ! 'sfi' weighted ch at the interface
1154 real(r8) :: cm ! 'sfi' weighted cm at the interface
1155 real(r8) :: bfact ! Buoyancy factor in n2 calculations
1156 real(r8) :: product ! Intermediate vars used to find slopes
1157 real(r8) :: dsldp_a, dqtdp_a ! Slopes across interface above
1158 real(r8) :: dsldp_b(pcols), dqtdp_b(pcols) ! Slopes across interface below
1159
1160 ! ----------------------- !
1161 ! Main Computation Begins !
1162 ! ----------------------- !
1163
1164 ! Calculate conservative scalars (qt,sl,slv) and buoyancy coefficients at the layer mid-points.
1165 ! Note that 'ntop_turb = 1', 'nbot_turb = pver'
1166
116778336007833600 do k = ntop_turb, nbot_turb
1168105768900227205000 call qsat( t(:ncol,k), pmid(:ncol,k), es(:ncol,k), qs(:ncol,k), gam=gam(:ncol,k))
1169105768900113602500 do i = 1, ncol
1170 qt(i,k) = qv(i,k) + ql(i,k) + qi(i,k)
1171 sl(i,k) = cpair * t(i,k) + g * z(i,k) - latvap * ql(i,k) - latsub * qi(i,k)
1172 slv(i,k) = sl(i,k) * ( 1._r8 + zvir * qt(i,k) )
1173 ! Thermodynamic coefficients for buoyancy flux - in this loop these are
1174 ! calculated at mid-points; later, they will be averaged to interfaces,
1175 ! where they will ultimately be used. At the surface, the coefficients
1176 ! are taken from the lowest mid point.
1177 bfact = g / ( t(i,k) * ( 1._r8 + zvir * qv(i,k) - ql(i,k) - qi(i,k) ) )
1178 chu(i,k) = ( 1._r8 + zvir * qt(i,k) ) * bfact / cpair
1179 chs(i,k) = ( ( 1._r8 + ( 1._r8 + zvir ) * gam(i,k) * cpair * t(i,k) / latvap ) / ( 1._r8 + gam(i,k) ) ) * bfact / cpair
1180 cmu(i,k) = zvir * bfact * t(i,k)
1181 cms(i,k) = latvap * chs(i,k) - bfact * t(i,k)
1182 end do
1183 end do
1184
118535256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1186 chu(i,pver+1) = chu(i,pver)
1187 chs(i,pver+1) = chs(i,pver)
1188 cmu(i,pver+1) = cmu(i,pver)
1189 cms(i,pver+1) = cms(i,pver)
1190 end do
1191
1192 ! Compute slopes of conserved variables sl, qt within each layer k.
1193 ! 'a' indicates the 'above' gradient from layer k-1 to layer k and
1194 ! 'b' indicates the 'below' gradient from layer k to layer k+1.
1195 ! We take a smaller (in absolute value) of these gradients as the
1196 ! slope within layer k. If they have opposite signs, gradient in
1197 ! layer k is taken to be zero. I should re-consider whether this
1198 ! profile reconstruction is the best or not.
1199 ! This is similar to the profile reconstruction used in the UWShCu.
1200
120135256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1202 ! Slopes at endpoints determined by extrapolation
1203 slslope(i,pver) = ( sl(i,pver) - sl(i,pver-1) ) / ( pmid(i,pver) - pmid(i,pver-1) )
1204 qtslope(i,pver) = ( qt(i,pver) - qt(i,pver-1) ) / ( pmid(i,pver) - pmid(i,pver-1) )
1205 slslope(i,1) = ( sl(i,2) - sl(i,1) ) / ( pmid(i,2) - pmid(i,1) )
1206 qtslope(i,1) = ( qt(i,2) - qt(i,1) ) / ( pmid(i,2) - pmid(i,1) )
1207 dsldp_b(i) = slslope(i,1)
1208 dqtdp_b(i) = qtslope(i,1)
1209 end do
1210
121173113607572480 do k = 2, pver - 1
121298717640106029000 do i = 1, ncol
12139871764098717640 dsldp_a = dsldp_b(i)
1214 dqtdp_a = dqtdp_b(i)
1215 dsldp_b(i) = ( sl(i,k+1) - sl(i,k) ) / ( pmid(i,k+1) - pmid(i,k) )
1216 dqtdp_b(i) = ( qt(i,k+1) - qt(i,k) ) / ( pmid(i,k+1) - pmid(i,k) )
1217 product = dsldp_a * dsldp_b(i)
1218 if( product .le. 0._r8 ) then
121919390751939075 slslope(i,k) = 0._r8
122096778565193557130 else if( product .gt. 0._r8 .and. dsldp_a .lt. 0._r8 ) then
12219506631395066313 slslope(i,k) = max( dsldp_a, dsldp_b(i) )
122217122523424504 else if( product .gt. 0._r8 .and. dsldp_a .gt. 0._r8 ) then
122317122521712252 slslope(i,k) = min( dsldp_a, dsldp_b(i) )
1224 end if
12259871764098717640 product = dqtdp_a*dqtdp_b(i)
1226 if( product .le. 0._r8 ) then
12271361840813618408 qtslope(i,k) = 0._r8
122885099232170198464 else if( product .gt. 0._r8 .and. dqtdp_a .lt. 0._r8 ) then
12291043658510436585 qtslope(i,k) = max( dqtdp_a, dqtdp_b(i) )
123074662647149325294 else if( product .gt. 0._r8 .and. dqtdp_a .gt. 0._r8 ) then
12317466264774662647 qtslope(i,k) = min( dqtdp_a, dqtdp_b(i) )
1232 end if
1233 end do ! i
1234 end do ! k
1235
1236 ! Compute saturation fraction at the interfacial layers for use in buoyancy
1237 ! flux computation.
1238
1239261120261120 call sfdiag( pcols , pver , ncol , qt , ql , sl , &
1240 pi , pmid , zi , cld , sfi , sfuh , &
1241 sflh , slslope , qtslope )
1242
1243 ! Calculate buoyancy coefficients at all interfaces (1:pver+1) and (n2,s2,ri)
1244 ! at all interfaces except surface. Note 'nbot_turb = pver', 'ntop_turb = 1'.
1245 ! With the previous definition of buoyancy coefficients at the surface, the
1246 ! resulting buoyancy coefficients at the top and surface interfaces becomes
1247 ! identical to the buoyancy coefficients at the top and bottom layers. Note
1248 ! that even though the dimension of (s2,n2,ri) is 'pver', they are defined
1249 ! at interfaces ( not at the layer mid-points ) except the surface.
1250
125175724807833600 do k = nbot_turb, ntop_turb + 1, -1
125275724807572480 km1 = k - 1
1253102243270102243270 do i = 1, ncol
1254 rdz = 1._r8 / ( z(i,km1) - z(i,k) )
1255 dsldz = ( sl(i,km1) - sl(i,k) ) * rdz
1256 dqtdz = ( qt(i,km1) - qt(i,k) ) * rdz
1257 chu(i,k) = ( chu(i,km1) + chu(i,k) ) * 0.5_r8
1258 chs(i,k) = ( chs(i,km1) + chs(i,k) ) * 0.5_r8
1259 cmu(i,k) = ( cmu(i,km1) + cmu(i,k) ) * 0.5_r8
1260 cms(i,k) = ( cms(i,km1) + cms(i,k) ) * 0.5_r8
1261 ch = chu(i,k) * ( 1._r8 - sfi(i,k) ) + chs(i,k) * sfi(i,k)
1262 cm = cmu(i,k) * ( 1._r8 - sfi(i,k) ) + cms(i,k) * sfi(i,k)
1263 n2(i,k) = ch * dsldz + cm * dqtdz
1264 s2(i,k) = ( ( u(i,km1) - u(i,k) )**2 + ( v(i,km1) - v(i,k) )**2) * rdz**2
1265 s2(i,k) = max( ntzero, s2(i,k) )
1266 ri(i,k) = n2(i,k) / s2(i,k)
1267 end do
1268 end do
126935256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1270 n2(i,1) = n2(i,2)
1271 s2(i,1) = s2(i,2)
1272 ri(i,1) = ri(i,2)
1273 end do
1274
1275 return
1276
1277 end subroutine trbintd
1278
1279 !=============================================================================== !
1280 ! !
1281 !=============================================================================== !
1282
1283261120261120 subroutine austausch_atm( pcols, pver, ncol, ri, s2, kvf )
1284
1285 !---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1286 ! !
1287 ! Purpose: Computes exchange coefficients for free turbulent flows. !
1288 ! This is not used in the UW moist turbulence scheme. !
1289 ! !
1290 ! Method: !
1291 ! !
1292 ! The free atmosphere diffusivities are based on standard mixing length !
1293 ! forms for the neutral diffusivity multiplied by functns of Richardson !
1294 ! number. K = l^2 * |dV/dz| * f(Ri). The same functions are used for !
1295 ! momentum, potential temperature, and constitutents. !
1296 ! !
1297 ! The stable Richardson num function (Ri>0) is taken from Holtslag and !
1298 ! Beljaars (1989), ECMWF proceedings. f = 1 / (1 + 10*Ri*(1 + 8*Ri)) !
1299 ! The unstable Richardson number function (Ri<0) is taken from CCM1. !
1300 ! f = sqrt(1 - 18*Ri) !
1301 ! !
1302 ! Author: B. Stevens (rewrite, August 2000) !
1303 ! !
1304 !---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1305 implicit none
1306
1307 ! --------------- !
1308 ! Input arguments !
1309 ! --------------- !
1310
1311 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
1312 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric layers
1313 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of atmospheric columns
1314
1315 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2(pcols,pver) ! Shear squared
1316 real(r8), intent(in) :: ri(pcols,pver) ! Richardson no
1317
1318 ! ---------------- !
1319 ! Output arguments !
1320 ! ---------------- !
1321
1322261120261120 real(r8), intent(out) :: kvf(pcols,pver+1) ! Eddy diffusivity for heat and tracers
1323
1324 ! --------------- !
1325 ! Local Variables !
1326 ! --------------- !
1327
1328 real(r8) :: fofri ! f(ri)
1329 real(r8) :: kvn ! Neutral Kv
1330
1331 integer :: i ! Longitude index
1332 integer :: k ! Vertical index
1333
1334 ! ----------------------- !
1335 ! Main Computation Begins !
1336 ! ----------------------- !
1337
1338109294530133839810 kvf(:ncol,:) = 0.0_r8
133935256304047870 kvf(:ncol,pver+1) = 0.0_r8
134035256304831230 kvf(:ncol,1:ntop_turb) = 0.0_r8
1341
1342 ! Compute the free atmosphere vertical diffusion coefficients: kvh = kvq = kvm.
1343
134475724807833600 do k = ntop_turb + 1, nbot_turb
1345102243270109815750 do i = 1, ncol
1346102243270102243270 if( ri(i,k) < 0.0_r8 ) then
134758920935892093 fofri = sqrt( max( 1._r8 - 18._r8 * ri(i,k), 0._r8 ) )
1348 else
13499635117796351177 fofri = 1.0_r8 / ( 1.0_r8 + 10.0_r8 * ri(i,k) * ( 1.0_r8 + 8.0_r8 * ri(i,k) ) )
1350 end if
1351 kvn = ml2(k) * sqrt(s2(i,k))
1352 kvf(i,k) = max( zkmin, kvn * fofri )
1353 end do
1354 end do
1355
1356 return
1357
1358261120261120 end subroutine austausch_atm
1359
1360 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1361 ! !
1362 ! The University of Washington Moist Turbulence Scheme !
1363 ! !
1364 ! Authors : Chris Bretherton at the University of Washington, Seattle, WA !
1365 ! Sungsu Park at the CGD/NCAR, Boulder, CO !
1366 ! !
1367 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1368
1369261120522240 subroutine caleddy( pcols , pver , ncol , &
1370 sl , qt , ql , slv , u , &
1371 v , pi , z , zi , &
1372 qflx , shflx , slslope , qtslope , &
1373 chu , chs , cmu , cms , sfuh , &
1374 sflh , n2 , s2 , ri , rrho , &
1375 pblh , ustar , &
1376 kvh_in , kvm_in , kvh , kvm , &
1377 tpert , qpert , qrlin , kvf , tke , &
1378 wstarent , bprod , sprod , minpblh , wpert , &
1379 tkes , went , turbtype , sm_aw , &
1380 kbase_o , ktop_o , ncvfin_o , &
1381 kbase_mg , ktop_mg , ncvfin_mg , &
1382 kbase_f , ktop_f , ncvfin_f , &
1383 wet_CL , web_CL , jtbu_CL , jbbu_CL , &
1384 evhc_CL , jt2slv_CL , n2ht_CL , n2hb_CL , lwp_CL , &
1385 opt_depth_CL , radinvfrac_CL, radf_CL , wstar_CL , wstar3fact_CL, &
1386 ebrk , wbrk , lbrk , ricl , ghcl , &
1387 shcl , smcl , &
1388 gh_a , sh_a , sm_a , ri_a , leng , &
1389 wcap , pblhp , cld , ipbl , kpblh , &
1390 wsedl , wsed_CL )
1391
1392 !--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1393 ! !
1394 ! Purpose : This is a driver routine to compute eddy diffusion coefficients !
1395 ! for heat (sl), momentum (u, v), moisture (qt), and other trace !
1396 ! constituents. This scheme uses first order closure for stable !
1397 ! turbulent layers (STL). For convective layers (CL), entrainment !
1398 ! closure is used at the CL external interfaces, which is coupled !
1399 ! to the diagnosis of a CL regime mean TKE from the instantaneous !
1400 ! thermodynamic and velocity profiles. The CLs are diagnosed by !
1401 ! extending original CL layers of moist static instability into !
1402 ! adjacent weakly stably stratified interfaces, stopping if the !
1403 ! stability is too strong. This allows a realistic depiction of !
1404 ! dry convective boundary layers with a downgradient approach. !
1405 ! !
1406 ! NOTE: This routine currently assumes ntop_turb = 1, nbot_turb = pver !
1407 ! ( turbulent diffusivities computed at all interior interfaces ) !
1408 ! and will require modification to handle a different ntop_turb. !
1409 ! !
1410 ! Authors: Sungsu Park and Chris Bretherton. 08/2006, 05/2008. !
1411 ! !
1412 ! For details, see !
1413 ! !
1414 ! 1. 'A new moist turbulence parametrization in the Community Atmosphere Model' !
1415 ! by Christopher S. Bretherton & Sungsu Park. J. Climate. 22. 3422-3448. 2009. !
1416 ! !
1417 ! 2. 'The University of Washington shallow convection and moist turbulence schemes !
1418 ! and their impact on climate simulations with the Community Atmosphere Model' !
1419 ! by Sungsu Park & Christopher S. Bretherton. J. Climate. 22. 3449-3469. 2009. !
1420 ! !
1421 ! For questions on the scheme and code, send an email to !
1422 ! sungsup@ucar.edu or breth@washington.edu !
1423 ! !
1424 !--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1425
1426 use pbl_utils, only: &
1427 compute_radf ! Subroutine for computing radf
1428
1429 ! ---------------- !
1430 ! Inputs variables !
1431 ! ---------------- !
1432
1433 implicit none
1434 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
1435 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric layers
1436 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of atmospheric columns
1437 real(r8), intent(in) :: u(pcols,pver) ! U wind [ m/s ]
1438 real(r8), intent(in) :: v(pcols,pver) ! V wind [ m/s ]
1439 real(r8), intent(in) :: sl(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water static energy, cp * T + g * z - Lv * ql - Ls * qi [ J/kg ]
1440 real(r8), intent(in) :: slv(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water virtual static energy, sl * ( 1 + 0.608 * qt ) [ J/kg ]
1441 real(r8), intent(in) :: qt(pcols,pver) ! Total speccific humidity qv + ql + qi [ kg/kg ]
1442 real(r8), intent(in) :: ql(pcols,pver) ! Liquid water specific humidity [ kg/kg ]
1443 real(r8), intent(in) :: pi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface pressures [ Pa ]
1444 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols,pver) ! Layer midpoint height above surface [ m ]
1445 real(r8), intent(in) :: zi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface height above surface, i.e., zi(pver+1) = 0 all over the globe
1446 ! [ m ]
1447 real(r8), intent(in) :: chu(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy coeffi. unsaturated sl (heat) coef. at all interfaces.
1448 ! [ unit ? ]
1449 real(r8), intent(in) :: chs(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy coeffi. saturated sl (heat) coef. at all interfaces.
1450 ! [ unit ? ]
1451 real(r8), intent(in) :: cmu(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy coeffi. unsaturated qt (moisture) coef. at all interfaces
1452 ! [ unit ? ]
1453 real(r8), intent(in) :: cms(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy coeffi. saturated qt (moisture) coef. at all interfaces
1454 ! [ unit ? ]
1455 real(r8), intent(in) :: sfuh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in upper half-layer [ fraction ]
1456 real(r8), intent(in) :: sflh(pcols,pver) ! Saturation fraction in lower half-layer [ fraction ]
1457 real(r8), intent(in) :: n2(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial (except surface) moist buoyancy frequency [ s-2 ]
1458 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial (except surface) shear frequency [ s-2 ]
1459 real(r8), intent(in) :: ri(pcols,pver) ! Interfacial (except surface) Richardson number
1460 real(r8), intent(in) :: qflx(pcols) ! Kinematic surface constituent ( water vapor ) flux [ kg/m2/s ]
1461 real(r8), intent(in) :: shflx(pcols) ! Kinematic surface heat flux [ unit ? ]
1462 real(r8), intent(in) :: slslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'sl' in each layer [ J/kg/Pa ]
1463 real(r8), intent(in) :: qtslope(pcols,pver) ! Slope of 'qt' in each layer [ kg/kg/Pa ]
1464 real(r8), intent(in) :: qrlin(pcols,pver) ! Input grid-mean LW heating rate : [ K/s ] * cpair * dp = [ W/kg*Pa ]
1465 real(r8), intent(in) :: wsedl(pcols,pver) ! Sedimentation velocity of liquid stratus cloud droplet [ m/s ]
1466 real(r8), intent(in) :: ustar(pcols) ! Surface friction velocity [ m/s ]
1467 real(r8), intent(in) :: rrho(pcols) ! 1./bottom mid-point density. Specific volume [ m3/kg ]
1468 real(r8), intent(in) :: kvf(pcols,pver+1) ! Free atmosphere eddy diffusivity [ m2/s ]
1469 logical, intent(in) :: wstarent ! Switch for choosing wstar3 entrainment parameterization
1470 real(r8), intent(in) :: minpblh(pcols) ! Minimum PBL height based on surface stress [ m ]
1471 real(r8), intent(in) :: kvh_in(pcols,pver+1) ! kvh saved from last timestep or last iterative step [ m2/s ]
1472 real(r8), intent(in) :: kvm_in(pcols,pver+1) ! kvm saved from last timestep or last iterative step [ m2/s ]
1473 real(r8), intent(in) :: cld(pcols,pver) ! Stratus Cloud Fraction [ fraction ]
1474
1475 ! ---------------- !
1476 ! Output variables !
1477 ! ---------------- !
1478
1479261120261120 real(r8), intent(out) :: kvh(pcols,pver+1) ! Eddy diffusivity for heat, moisture, and tracers [ m2/s ]
1480261120261120 real(r8), intent(out) :: kvm(pcols,pver+1) ! Eddy diffusivity for momentum [ m2/s ]
1481 real(r8), intent(out) :: pblh(pcols) ! PBL top height [ m ]
1482 real(r8), intent(out) :: pblhp(pcols) ! PBL top height pressure [ Pa ]
1483 real(r8), intent(out) :: tpert(pcols) ! Convective temperature excess [ K ]
1484 real(r8), intent(out) :: qpert(pcols) ! Convective humidity excess [ kg/kg ]
1485 real(r8), intent(out) :: wpert(pcols) ! Turbulent velocity excess [ m/s ]
1486 real(r8), intent(out) :: tkes(pcols) ! TKE at surface [ m2/s2 ]
1487 real(r8), intent(out) :: went(pcols) ! Entrainment rate at the PBL top interface [ m/s ]
1488261120261120 real(r8), intent(out) :: tke(pcols,pver+1) ! Turbulent kinetic energy [ m2/s2 ], 'tkes' at surface, pver+1.
1489 real(r8), intent(out) :: bprod(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy production [ m2/s3 ], 'bflxs' at surface, pver+1.
1490 real(r8), intent(out) :: sprod(pcols,pver+1) ! Shear production [ m2/s3 ], (ustar(i)**3)/(vk*z(i,pver))
1491 ! at surface, pver+1.
1492261120261120 integer(i4), intent(out) :: turbtype(pcols,pver+1) ! Turbulence type at each interface:
1493 ! 0. = Non turbulence interface
1494 ! 1. = Stable turbulence interface
1495 ! 2. = CL interior interface ( if bflxs > 0, surface is this )
1496 ! 3. = Bottom external interface of CL
1497 ! 4. = Top external interface of CL.
1498 ! 5. = Double entraining CL external interface
1499 real(r8), intent(out) :: sm_aw(pcols,pver+1) ! Galperin instability function of momentum for use in the microphysics
1500 ! [ no unit ]
1501 integer(i4), intent(out) :: ipbl(pcols) ! If 1, PBL is CL, while if 0, PBL is STL.
1502 integer(i4), intent(out) :: kpblh(pcols) ! Layer index containing PBL within or at the base interface
1503 real(r8), intent(out) :: wsed_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Sedimentation velocity at the top of each CL [ m/s ]
1504
1505 ! --------------------------- !
1506 ! Diagnostic output variables !
1507 ! --------------------------- !
1508
1509 real(r8) :: kbase_o(pcols,ncvmax) ! Original external base interface index of CL just after 'exacol'
1510 real(r8) :: ktop_o(pcols,ncvmax) ! Original external top interface index of CL just after 'exacol'
1511 real(r8) :: ncvfin_o(pcols) ! Original number of CLs just after 'exacol'
1512 real(r8) :: kbase_mg(pcols,ncvmax) ! kbase just after extending-merging (after 'zisocl') but without SRCL
1513 real(r8) :: ktop_mg(pcols,ncvmax) ! ktop just after extending-merging (after 'zisocl') but without SRCL
1514 real(r8) :: ncvfin_mg(pcols) ! ncvfin just after extending-merging (after 'zisocl') but without SRCL
1515 real(r8) :: kbase_f(pcols,ncvmax) ! Final kbase after adding SRCL
1516 real(r8) :: ktop_f(pcols,ncvmax) ! Final ktop after adding SRCL
1517 real(r8) :: ncvfin_f(pcols) ! Final ncvfin after adding SRCL
1518 real(r8) :: wet_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Entrainment rate at the CL top [ m/s ]
1519 real(r8) :: web_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Entrainment rate at the CL base [ m/s ]
1520 real(r8) :: jtbu_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy jump across the CL top [ m/s2 ]
1521 real(r8) :: jbbu_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy jump across the CL base [ m/s2 ]
1522 real(r8) :: evhc_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Evaporative enhancement factor at the CL top
1523 real(r8) :: jt2slv_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Jump of slv ( across two layers ) at CL top for use only in evhc [ J/kg ]
1524 real(r8) :: n2ht_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! n2 defined at the CL top interface
1525 ! but using sfuh(kt) instead of sfi(kt) [ s-2 ]
1526 real(r8) :: n2hb_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! n2 defined at the CL base interface
1527 ! but using sflh(kb-1) instead of sfi(kb) [ s-2 ]
1528 real(r8) :: lwp_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! LWP in the CL top layer [ kg/m2 ]
1529 real(r8) :: opt_depth_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Optical depth of the CL top layer
1530 real(r8) :: radinvfrac_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Fraction of LW radiative cooling confined in the top portion of CL
1531 real(r8) :: radf_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Buoyancy production at the CL top due to radiative cooling [ m2/s3 ]
1532 real(r8) :: wstar_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! Convective velocity of CL including entrainment contribution finally [ m/s ]
1533 real(r8) :: wstar3fact_CL(pcols,ncvmax) ! "wstar3fact" of CL. Entrainment enhancement of wstar3 (inverse)
1534
1535 real(r8) :: gh_a(pcols,pver+1) ! Half of normalized buoyancy production, -l2n2/2e. [ no unit ]
1536 real(r8) :: sh_a(pcols,pver+1) ! Galperin instability function of heat-moisture at all interfaces [ no unit ]
1537 real(r8) :: sm_a(pcols,pver+1) ! Galperin instability function of momentum at all interfaces [ no unit ]
1538 real(r8) :: ri_a(pcols,pver+1) ! Interfacial Richardson number at all interfaces [ no unit ]
1539
1540 real(r8) :: ebrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Net CL mean TKE [ m2/s2 ]
1541 real(r8) :: wbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Net CL mean normalized TKE [ m2/s2 ]
1542 real(r8) :: lbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Net energetic integral thickness of CL [ m ]
1543 real(r8) :: ricl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Mean Richardson number of CL ( l2n2/l2s2 )
1544 real(r8) :: ghcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Half of normalized buoyancy production of CL
1545 real(r8) :: shcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Instability function of heat and moisture of CL
1546 real(r8) :: smcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Instability function of momentum of CL
1547
1548261120261120 real(r8) :: leng(pcols,pver+1) ! Turbulent length scale [ m ], 0 at the surface.
1549261120261120 real(r8) :: wcap(pcols,pver+1) ! Normalized TKE [m2/s2], 'tkes/b1' at the surface and 'tke/b1' at
1550 ! the top/bottom entrainment interfaces of CL assuming no transport.
1551 ! ------------------------ !

1768 ! Initialize 'bprod' [ m2/s3 ] and 'sprod' [ m2/s3 ] at all interfaces.
1769 ! Note this initialization is a hybrid initialization since 'n2' [s-2] and 's2' [s-2]
1770 ! are calculated from the given current initial profile, while 'kvh_in' [m2/s] and
1771 ! 'kvm_in' [m2/s] are from the previous iteration or previous time step.

1773 ! 'caleddy' subroutine for diagnostic output.

177675724807833600 do k = 2, pver

1780 end do

1783 ! Set 'bprod' and 'sprod' at top and bottom interface.
1784 ! In calculating 'surface' (actually lowest half-layer) buoyancy flux,
1785 ! 'chu' at surface is defined to be the same as 'chu' at the mid-point
1786 ! of lowest model layer (pver) at the end of 'trbind'. The same is for
1787 ! the other buoyancy coefficients. 'sprod(i,pver+1)' is defined in a
1788 ! consistent way as the definition of 'tkes' in the original code.
1789 ! ( Important Option ) If I want to isolate surface buoyancy flux from
1790 ! the other parts of CL regimes energetically even though bflxs > 0,
1791 ! all I should do is to re-define 'bprod(i,pver+1)=0' in the below 'do'
1792 ! block. Additionally for merging test of extending SBCL based on 'l2n2'
1793 ! in 'zisocl', I should use 'l2n2 = - wint / sh' for similar treatment
1794 ! as previous code. All other parts of the code are fully consistently
1795 ! treated by these change only.

179835256303786750 do i = 1, ncol

1800 sprod(i,1) = 0._r8 ! Top interface
1801 ch = chu(i,pver+1) * ( 1._r8 - sflh(i,pver) ) + chs(i,pver+1) * sflh(i,pver)
1802 cm = cmu(i,pver+1) * ( 1._r8 - sflh(i,pver) ) + cms(i,pver+1) * sflh(i,pver)
1803 bflxs(i) = ch * shflx(i) * rrho(i) + cm * qflx(i) * rrho(i)
180435256303525630 if( choice_tkes .eq. 'ibprod' ) then
180535256303525630 bprod(i,pver+1) = bflxs(i)
1806 else
180700 bprod(i,pver+1) = 0._r8
1808 endif
1809 sprod(i,pver+1) = (ustar(i)**3)/(vk*z(i,pver))
1810 end do

1816 ! Note that if surface buoyancy flux is positive ( bflxs = bprod(i,pver+1) > 0 ),
1817 ! surface interface is identified as an internal interface of CL. However, even
1818 ! though bflxs <= 0, if 'pver' interface is a CL internal interface (ri(pver)<0),
1819 ! surface interface is identified as an external interface of CL. If bflxs =< 0
1820 ! and ri(pver) >= 0, then surface interface is identified as a stable turbulent
1821 ! intereface (STL) as shown at the end of 'caleddy'. Even though a 'minpblh' is
1822 ! passed into 'exacol', it is not used in the 'exacol'.

1825

182835256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1829105768900109294530 do k = 1, ncvmax
1830 kbase_o(i,k) = real(kbase(i,k),r8)
1831 ktop_o(i,k) = real(ktop(i,k),r8)
1832 ncvfin_o(i) = real(ncvfin(i),r8)

1834 end do

1837 ! Perform calculation for each column !
1838 ! ----------------------------------- !

184035256303786750 do i = 1, ncol
1841
1842 ! Define Surface Interfacial Layer TKE, 'tkes'.
1843 ! In the current code, 'tkes' is used as representing TKE of surface interfacial
1844 ! layer (low half-layer of surface-based grid layer). In the code, when bflxs>0,
1845 ! surface interfacial layer is assumed to be energetically coupled to the other
1846 ! parts of the CL regime based at the surface. In this sense, it is conceptually
1847 ! more reasonable to include both 'bprod' and 'sprod' in the definition of 'tkes'.
1848 ! Since 'tkes' cannot be negative, it is lower bounded by small positive number.
1849 ! Note that inclusion of 'bprod' in the definition of 'tkes' may increase 'ebrk'
1850 ! and 'wstar3', and eventually, 'wet' at the CL top, especially when 'bflxs>0'.
1851 ! This might help to solve the problem of too shallow PBLH over the overcast Sc
1852 ! regime. If I want to exclude 'bprod(i,pver+1)' in calculating 'tkes' even when
1853 ! bflxs > 0, all I should to do is to set 'bprod(i,pver+1) = 0' in the above
1854 ! initialization 'do' loop (explained above), NOT changing the formulation of
1855 ! tkes(i) in the below block. This is because for consistent treatment in the
1856 ! other parts of the code also.
1857
1858 ! tkes(i) = (b1*vk*z(i,pver)*sprod(i,pver+1))**(2._r8/3._r8)
185935256307051260 tkes(i) = max(b1*vk*z(i,pver)*(bprod(i,pver+1)+sprod(i,pver+1)), 1.e-7_r8)**(2._r8/3._r8)
1860 tkes(i) = min(tkes(i), tkemax)
1861 tke(i,pver+1) = tkes(i)
1862 wcap(i,pver+1) = tkes(i)/b1
1863
1864 ! Extend and merge the initially identified CLs, relabel the CLs, and calculate

1867 ! with height. The following outputs are from 'zisocl'. Here, the dimension
1868 ! of below outputs are (pcols,ncvmax) (except the 'ncvfin(pcols)' and
1869 ! 'belongcv(pcols,pver+1)) and 'ncv' goes from 1 to 'ncvfin'.
1870 ! For 'ncv = ncvfin+1, ncvmax', below output are already initialized to be zero.
1871 ! ncvfin : Total number of CLs
1872 ! kbase(ncv) : Base external interface index of CL
1873 ! ktop : Top external interface index of CL
1874 ! belongcv : True if the interface (either internal or external) is CL
1875 ! ricl : Mean Richardson number of internal CL
1876 ! ghcl : Normalized buoyancy production '-l2n2/2e' [no unit] of internal CL
1877 ! shcl : Galperin instability function of heat-moisture of internal CL
1878 ! smcl : Galperin instability function of momentum of internal CL
1879 ! lbrk, <l>int : Thickness of (energetically) internal CL (lint, [m])
1880 ! wbrk, <W>int : Mean normalized TKE of internal CL ([m2/s2])
1881 ! ebrk, <e>int : Mean TKE of internal CL (b1*wbrk,[m2/s2])
1882 ! The ncvsurf is an identifier saying which CL regime is based at the surface.
1883 ! If 'ncvsurf=1', then the first CL regime is based at the surface. If surface

1886 ! identified SRCLs are simply appended to the normal CL regimes using regime

1890 ! 'ncvfin+1') is based at surface, then 'ncvsurf = ncvfin+1'. Thus 'ncvsurf' can
1891 ! be 0, 1, or >1. 'ncvsurf' can be a useful diagnostic output.
1892
1893 ncvsurf = 0
1894 if( ncvfin(i) .gt. 0 ) then
189528527292852729 call zisocl( pcols , pver , i , &
1896 z , zi , n2 , s2 , &
1897 bprod , sprod , bflxs , tkes , &
1898 ncvfin , kbase , ktop , belongcv, &
1899 ricl , ghcl , shcl , smcl , &
1900 lbrk , wbrk , ebrk , &
1901 extend , extend_up, extend_dn )
190228527295500217 if( kbase(i,1) .eq. pver + 1 ) ncvsurf = 1
1903 else
19042085993121532832 belongcv(i,:) = .false.
1905 endif

1907 ! Diagnostic output after finishing extending-merging process in 'zisocl'

1910105768900109294530 do k = 1, ncvmax
1911 kbase_mg(i,k) = real(kbase(i,k))
1912 ktop_mg(i,k) = real(ktop(i,k))

1916 ! ----------------------- !
1917 ! Identification of SRCLs !
1918 ! ----------------------- !
1919
1920 ! Modification : This cannot identify the 'cirrus' layer due to the condition of
1921 ! ql(i,k) .gt. qmin. This should be modified in future to identify
1922 ! a single thin cirrus layer.
1923 ! Instead of ql, we may use cldn in future, including ice
1924 ! contribution.
1925
1926 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1927 ! Find single-layer radiatively-driven cloud-topped convective layers (SRCLs). !
1928 ! SRCLs extend through a single model layer k, with entrainment at the top and !
1929 ! bottom interfaces, unless bottom interface is the surface. !
1930 ! The conditions for an SRCL is identified are: !
1931 ! !
1932 ! 1. Cloud in the layer, k : ql(i,k) .gt. qmin = 1.e-5 [ kg/kg ] !
1933 ! 2. No cloud in the above layer (else assuming that some fraction of the LW !
1934 ! flux divergence in layer k is concentrated at just below top interface !
1935 ! of layer k is invalid). Then, this condition might be sensitive to the !
1936 ! vertical resolution of grid. !
1937 ! 3. LW radiative cooling (SW heating is assumed uniformly distributed through !
1938 ! layer k, so not relevant to buoyancy production) in the layer k. However, !
1939 ! SW production might also contribute, which may be considered in a future. !
1940 ! 4. Internal stratification 'n2ht' of upper-half layer should be unstable. !
1941 ! The 'n2ht' is pure internal stratification of upper half layer, obtained !
1942 ! using internal slopes of sl, qt in layer k (in contrast to conventional !
1943 ! interfacial slope) and saturation fraction in the upper-half layer, !
1944 ! sfuh(k) (in contrast to sfi(k)). !
1945 ! 5. Top and bottom interfaces not both in the same existing convective layer. !
1946 ! If SRCL is within the previouisly identified CL regimes, we don't define !
1947 ! a new SRCL. !
1948 ! 6. k >= ntop_turb + 1 = 2 !
1949 ! 7. Ri at the top interface > ricrit = 0.19 (otherwise turbulent mixing will !
1950 ! broadly distribute the cloud top in the vertical, preventing localized !
1951 ! radiative destabilization at the top interface). !
1952 ! !
1953 ! Note if 'k = pver', it identifies a surface-based single fog layer, possibly, !
1954 ! warm advection fog. Note also the CL regime index of SRCLs itself increases !
1955 ! with height similar to the regular CLs indices identified from 'zisocl'. !
1956 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1957
195835256303525630 ncv = 1
1959 ncvf = ncvfin(i)
1960
196135256303525630 if( choice_SRCL .eq. 'remove' ) goto 222
1962
1963102243270105768900 do k = nbot_turb, ntop_turb + 1, -1 ! 'k = pver, 2, -1' is a layer index.
1964
1965102243270112362652 if( ql(i,k) .gt. qmin .and. ql(i,k-1) .lt. qmin .and. qrlw(i,k) .lt. 0._r8 &
1966 .and. ri(i,k) .ge. ricrit ) then

1978

1991
199214391591439159 in_CL = .false.

199414391592329176 do while ( ncv .le. ncvf )
1995993061993061 if( ktop(i,ncv) .le. k ) then
1996103044103044 if( kbase(i,ncv) .gt. k ) then
199700 in_CL = .true.

2001890017890017 ncv = ncv + 1 ! Go up one CL

2008
200914391591439159 ncvfin(i) = ncvfin(i) + 1
2010 ncvnew = ncvfin(i)

2014 belongcv(i,k+1) = .true.

2016 ! Calculate internal energy of SRCL. There is no internal energy if
2017 ! SRCL is elevated from the surface. Also, we simply assume neutral
2018 ! stability function. Note that this assumption of neutral stability
2019 ! does not influence numerical calculation- stability functions here
2020 ! are just for diagnostic output. In general SRCLs other than a SRCL
2021 ! based at surface with bflxs <= 0, there is no other way but to use
2022 ! neutral stability function. However, in case of SRCL based at the
2023 ! surface, we can explicitly calculate non-zero stability functions
2024 ! in a consistent way. Even though stability functions of SRCL are
2025 ! just diagnostic outputs not influencing numerical calculations, it
2026 ! would be informative to write out correct reasonable values rather
2027 ! than simply assuming neutral stability. I am doing this right now.
2028 ! Similar calculations were done for the SBCL and when surface inter
2029 ! facial layer was merged by overlying CL in 'ziscol'.
2030
2031 if( k .lt. pver ) then
2032
203314067561406756 wbrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2034 ebrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2035 lbrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2036 ghcl(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2037 shcl(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2038 smcl(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2039 ricl(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2040
2041 else ! Surface-based fog
2042
20433240332403 if( bflxs(i) .gt. 0._r8 ) then ! Incorporate surface TKE into CL interior energy
2044 ! It is likely that this case cannot exist since

204700 ebrk(i,ncvnew) = tkes(i)
2048 lbrk(i,ncvnew) = z(i,pver)

205100 write(iulog,*) 'Major mistake in SRCL: bflxs > 0 for surface-based SRCL'
205200 write(iulog,*) 'bflxs = ', bflxs(i)
205300 write(iulog,*) 'ncvfin_o = ', ncvfin_o(i)

205500 do ks = 1, ncvmax

2057 end do
205800 call endrun('CALEDDY: Major mistake in SRCL: bflxs > 0 for surface-based SRCL')
2059
2060 else ! Don't incorporate surface interfacial TKE into CL interior energy
2061
20623240332403 ebrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2063 lbrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2064 wbrk(i,ncvnew) = 0._r8
2065
2066 endif

2068 ! Calculate stability functions (ghcl, shcl, smcl, ricl) explicitly
2069 ! using an reverse procedure starting from tkes(i). Note that it is
2070 ! possible to calculate stability functions even when bflxs < 0.
2071 ! Previous code just assumed neutral stability functions. Note that
2072 ! since alph5 = 0.7 > 0, alph3 = -35 < 0, the denominator of gh is
2073 ! always positive if bflxs > 0. However, if bflxs < 0, denominator
2074 ! can be zero. For this case, we provide a possible maximum negative
2075 ! value (the most stable state) to gh. Note also tkes(i) is always a
2076 ! positive value by a limiter. Also, sprod(i,pver+1) > 0 by limiter.
2077
20783240364806 gg = 0.5_r8 * vk * z(i,pver) * bprod(i,pver+1) / ( tkes(i)**(3._r8/2._r8) )
2079 if( abs(alph5-gg*alph3) .le. 1.e-7_r8 ) then
2080 ! gh = -0.28_r8
2081 ! gh = -3.5334_r8
208200 gh = ghmin
2083 else
20843240332403 gh = gg / ( alph5 - gg * alph3 )
2085 end if
2086 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
2087 ! gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
20883240332403 gh = min(max(gh,ghmin),0.0233_r8)
2089 ghcl(i,ncvnew) = gh
2090 shcl(i,ncvnew) = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
2091 smcl(i,ncvnew) = max(0._r8,(alph1 + alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4exs*gh))
2092 ricl(i,ncvnew) = -(smcl(i,ncvnew)/shcl(i,ncvnew))*(bprod(i,pver+1)/sprod(i,pver+1))
2093
2094 ! 'ncvsurf' is CL regime index based at the surface. If there is no
2095 ! such regime, then 'ncvsurf = 0'.
2096
2097 ncvsurf = ncvnew
2098
2099 end if
2100
2101 end if
2102
2103 end if
2104
2105 end if
2106
2107 220 continue
2108
2109 end do ! End of 'k' loop where 'k' is a grid layer index running from 'pver' to 2
2110
2111 222 continue
