2113 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2114 ! Up to this point, we identified all kinds of CL regimes : !
2115 ! 1. A SBCL. By construction, 'bflxs > 0' for SBCL. !
2116 ! 2. Surface-based CL with multiple layers and 'bflxs =< 0' !
2117 ! 3. Surface-based CL with multiple layers and 'bflxs > 0' !
2118 ! 4. Regular elevated CL with two entraining interfaces !
2119 ! 5. SRCLs. If SRCL is based at surface, it will be bflxs < 0. !
2120 ! '1-4' were identified from 'zisocl' while '5' were identified separately !
2121 ! after performing 'zisocl'. CL regime index of '1-4' increases with height !
2122 ! ( e.g., CL = 1 is the CL regime nearest to the surface ) while CL regime !
2123 ! index of SRCL is simply appended after the final index of CL regimes from !
2124 ! 'zisocl'. However, CL regime indices of SRCLs itself increases with height !
2125 ! when there are multiple SRCLs, similar to the regular CLs from 'zisocl'. !
2126 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2127
2128 ! Diagnostic output of final CL regimes indices
2129
2130105768900109294530 do k = 1, ncvmax
2131 kbase_f(i,k) = real(kbase(i,k))
2132 ktop_f(i,k) = real(ktop(i,k))
2133 ncvfin_f(i) = real(ncvfin(i))
2134 end do
2135
2136 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2137 ! Compute radf for each CL in column by calling subroutine compute_radf !
2138 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2139105768900222114690 call compute_radf( choice_radf, i, pcols, pver, ncvmax, ncvfin, ktop, qmin, &
2140105768900451280640 ql, pi, qrlw, g, cldeff, zi, chs, lwp_CL(i,:), opt_depth_CL(i,:), &
2141105768900232691580 radinvfrac_CL(i,:), radf_CL(i,:) )
2142
2143 ! ---------------------------------------- !
2144 ! Perform do loop for individual CL regime !
2145 ! ---------------------------------------- ! -------------------------------- !
2146 ! For individual CLs, compute !
2147 ! 1. Entrainment rates at the CL top and (if any) base interfaces using !
2148 ! appropriate entrainment closure (current code use 'wstar' closure). !
2149 ! 2. Net CL mean (i.e., including entrainment contribution) TKE (ebrk) !
2150 ! and normalized TKE (wbrk). !
2151 ! 3. TKE (tke) and normalized TKE (wcap) profiles at all CL interfaces. !
2152 ! 4. ( kvm, kvh ) profiles at all CL interfaces. !
2153 ! 5. ( bprod, sprod ) profiles at all CL interfaces. !
2154 ! Also calculate !
2155 ! 1. PBL height as the top external interface of surface-based CL, if any. !
2156 ! 2. Characteristic excesses of convective 'updraft velocity (wpert)', !
2157 ! 'temperature (tpert)', and 'moisture (qpert)' in the surface-based CL, !
2158 ! if any, for use in the separate convection scheme. !
2159 ! If there is no surface-based CL, 'PBL height' and 'convective excesses' are !
2160 ! calculated later from surface-based STL (Stable Turbulent Layer) properties.!
2161 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2162
216335256303525630 ktblw = 0
216447773604777360 do ncv = 1, ncvfin(i)
2165
216647773604777360 kt = ktop(i,ncv)
2167 kb = kbase(i,ncv)
2168
2169 lwp = lwp_CL(i,ncv)
2170 opt_depth = opt_depth_CL(i,ncv)
2171 radinvfrac = radinvfrac_CL(i,ncv)
2172 radf = radf_CL(i, ncv)
2173
2174 ! Check whether surface interface is energetically interior or not.
217526798912679891 if( kb .eq. (pver+1) .and. bflxs(i) .le. 0._r8 ) then
21765454754547 lbulk = zi(i,kt) - z(i,pver)
2177 else
217847228134722813 lbulk = zi(i,kt) - zi(i,kb)
2179 end if
218047773604777360 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
2181
2182 ! Calculate 'turbulent length scale (leng)' and 'normalized TKE (wcap)'
2183 ! at all CL interfaces except the surface. Note that below 'wcap' at
2184 ! external interfaces are not correct. However, it does not influence
2185 ! numerical calculation and correct normalized TKE at the entraining
2186 ! interfaces will be re-calculated at the end of this 'do ncv' loop.
2187
21881289093612890936 do k = min(kb,pver), kt, -1
21891289093612890936 if( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampcl' ) then
2190 ! In order to treat the case of 'ricl(i,ncv) >> 0' of surface-based SRCL
2191 ! with 'bflxs(i) < 0._r8', I changed ricl(i,ncv) -> min(0._r8,ricl(i,ncv))
2192 ! in the below exponential. This is necessary to prevent the model crash
2193 ! by too large values (e.g., 700) of ricl(i,ncv)
21941289093612890936 tunlramp = ctunl*tunl*(1._r8-(1._r8-1._r8/ctunl)*exp(min(0._r8,ricl(i,ncv))))
2195 tunlramp = min(max(tunlramp,tunl),ctunl*tunl)
219600 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then
219700 tunlramp = ctunl*tunl
2198 ! tunlramp = 0.765_r8
2199 else
220000 tunlramp = tunl
2201 endif
22021289093612890936 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then
22031289093651563744 leng(i,k) = ( (vk*zi(i,k))**(-cleng) + (tunlramp*lbulk)**(-cleng) )**(-1._r8/cleng)
2204 ! leng(i,k) = vk*zi(i,k) / (1._r8+vk*zi(i,k)/(tunlramp*lbulk))
2205 else
220600 leng(i,k) = min( vk*zi(i,k), tunlramp*lbulk )
2207 endif
2208 leng(i,k) = min(leng_max(k), leng(i,k))
2209 wcap(i,k) = (leng(i,k)**2) * (-shcl(i,ncv)*n2(i,k)+smcl(i,ncv)*s2(i,k))
2210 end do ! k
2211
2212 ! Calculate basic cross-interface variables ( jump condition ) across the
2213 ! base external interface of CL.
2214
221547773604777360 if( kb .lt. pver+1 ) then
2216
221720974692097469 jbzm = z(i,kb-1) - z(i,kb) ! Interfacial layer thickness [m]
2218 jbsl = sl(i,kb-1) - sl(i,kb) ! Interfacial jump of 'sl' [J/kg]
2219 jbqt = qt(i,kb-1) - qt(i,kb) ! Interfacial jump of 'qt' [kg/kg]
2220 jbbu = n2(i,kb) * jbzm ! Interfacial buoyancy jump [m/s2]
2221 ! considering saturation ( > 0 )
2222 jbbu = max(jbbu,jbumin) ! Set minimum buoyancy jump, jbumin = 1.e-3
2223 jbu = u(i,kb-1) - u(i,kb) ! Interfacial jump of 'u' [m/s]
2224 jbv = v(i,kb-1) - v(i,kb) ! Interfacial jump of 'v' [m/s]
2225 ch = (1._r8 -sflh(i,kb-1))*chu(i,kb) + sflh(i,kb-1)*chs(i,kb) ! Buoyancy coefficient just above the base interface
2226 cm = (1._r8 -sflh(i,kb-1))*cmu(i,kb) + sflh(i,kb-1)*cms(i,kb) ! Buoyancy coefficient just above the base interface
2227 n2hb = (ch*jbsl + cm*jbqt)/jbzm ! Buoyancy frequency [s-2]
2228 ! just above the base interface
2229 vyb = n2hb*jbzm/jbbu ! Ratio of 'n2hb/n2' at 'kb' interface
2230 vub = min(1._r8,(jbu**2+jbv**2)/(jbbu*jbzm) ) ! Ratio of 's2/n2 = 1/Ri' at 'kb' interface
2231
2232 else
2233
2234 ! Below setting is necessary for consistent treatment when 'kb' is at the surface.
223526798912679891 jbbu = 0._r8
2236 n2hb = 0._r8
2237 vyb = 0._r8
2238 vub = 0._r8
2239 web = 0._r8
2240
2241 end if
2242
2243 ! Calculate basic cross-interface variables ( jump condition ) across the
2244 ! top external interface of CL. The meanings of variables are similar to
2245 ! the ones at the base interface.
2246
224747773604777360 jtzm = z(i,kt-1) - z(i,kt)
2248 jtsl = sl(i,kt-1) - sl(i,kt)
2249 jtqt = qt(i,kt-1) - qt(i,kt)
2250 jtbu = n2(i,kt)*jtzm ! Note : 'jtbu' is guaranteed positive by definition of CL top.
2251 jtbu = max(jtbu,jbumin) ! But threshold it anyway to be sure.
2252 jtu = u(i,kt-1) - u(i,kt)
2253 jtv = v(i,kt-1) - v(i,kt)
2254 ch = (1._r8 -sfuh(i,kt))*chu(i,kt) + sfuh(i,kt)*chs(i,kt)
2255 cm = (1._r8 -sfuh(i,kt))*cmu(i,kt) + sfuh(i,kt)*cms(i,kt)
2256 n2ht = (ch*jtsl + cm*jtqt)/jtzm
2257 vyt = n2ht*jtzm/jtbu
2258 vut = min(1._r8,(jtu**2+jtv**2)/(jtbu*jtzm))
2259
2260 ! Evaporative enhancement factor of entrainment rate at the CL top interface, evhc.
2261 ! We take the full inversion strength to be 'jt2slv = slv(i,kt-2)-slv(i,kt)'
2262 ! where 'kt-1' is in the ambiguous layer. However, for a cloud-topped CL overlain
2263 ! by another CL, it is possible that 'slv(i,kt-2) < slv(i,kt)'. To avoid negative
2264 ! or excessive evhc, we lower-bound jt2slv and upper-bound evhc. Note 'jtslv' is
2265 ! used only for calculating 'evhc' : when calculating entrainment rate, we will
2266 ! use normal interfacial buoyancy jump across CL top interface.
2267
2268 evhc = 1._r8
2269 jt2slv = 0._r8
2270
2271 ! Modification : I should check whether below 'jbumin' produces reasonable limiting value.
2272 ! In addition, our current formulation does not consider ice contribution.
2273
227447773604777360 if( choice_evhc .eq. 'orig' ) then
2275
227600 if( ql(i,kt) .gt. qmin .and. ql(i,kt-1) .lt. qmin ) then
227700 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2278 jt2slv = max( jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g )
2279 evhc = 1._r8 + a2l * a3l * latvap * ql(i,kt) / jt2slv
2280 evhc = min( evhc, evhcmax )
2281 end if
2282
228347773604777360 elseif( choice_evhc .eq. 'ramp' ) then
2284
228500 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2286 jt2slv = max( jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g )
2287 evhc = 1._r8 + max(cldeff(i,kt)-cldeff(i,kt-1),0._r8) * a2l * a3l * latvap * ql(i,kt) / jt2slv
2288 evhc = min( evhc, evhcmax )
2289
229047773604777360 elseif( choice_evhc .eq. 'maxi' ) then
2291
229247773604777360 qleff = max( ql(i,kt-1), ql(i,kt) )
2293 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2294 jt2slv = max( jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g )
2295 evhc = 1._r8 + a2l * a3l * latvap * qleff / jt2slv
2296 evhc = min( evhc, evhcmax )
2297
2298 endif

2300 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2301 ! Calculate 'wstar3' by summing buoyancy productions within CL from !
2302 ! 1. Interior buoyancy production ( bprod: fcn of TKE ) !
2303 ! 2. Cloud-top radiative cooling !
2304 ! 3. Surface buoyancy flux contribution only when bflxs > 0. !
2305 ! Note that master length scale, lbulk, has already been !
2306 ! corrctly defined at the first part of this 'do ncv' loop !
2307 ! considering the sign of bflxs. !
2308 ! This 'wstar3' is used for calculation of entrainment rate. !
2309 ! Note that this 'wstar3' formula does not include shear production !
2310 ! and the effect of drizzle, which should be included later. !
2311 ! Q : Strictly speaking, in calculating interior buoyancy production, !
2312 ! the use of 'bprod' is not correct, since 'bprod' is not correct !
2313 ! value but initially guessed value. More reasonably, we should !
2314 ! use '-leng(i,k)*sqrt(b1*wcap(i,k))*shcl(i,ncv)*n2(i,k)' instead !
2315 ! of 'bprod(i,k)', although this is still an approximation since !
2316 ! tke(i,k) is not exactly 'b1*wcap(i,k)' due to a transport term.!
2317 ! However since iterative calculation will be performed after all,!
2318 ! below might also be OK. But I should test this alternative. !
2319 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2320
232147773604777360 dzht = zi(i,kt) - z(i,kt) ! Thickness of CL top half-layer
2322 dzhb = z(i,kb-1) - zi(i,kb) ! Thickness of CL bot half-layer
2323 wstar3 = radf * dzht
232460161076016107 do k = kt + 1, kb - 1 ! If 'kt = kb - 1', this loop will not be performed.
2325 wstar3 = wstar3 + bprod(i,k) * ( z(i,k-1) - z(i,k) )
2326 ! Below is an alternative which may speed up convergence.
2327 ! However, for interfaces merged into original CL, it can
2328 ! be 'wcap(i,k)<0' since 'n2(i,k)>0'. Thus, I should use
2329 ! the above original one.
2330 ! wstar3 = wstar3 - leng(i,k)*sqrt(b1*wcap(i,k))*shcl(i,ncv)*n2(i,k)* &
2331 ! (z(i,k-1) - z(i,k))
2332 end do
233347773607457251 if( kb .eq. (pver+1) .and. bflxs(i) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
233426253442625344 wstar3 = wstar3 + bflxs(i) * dzhb
2335 ! wstar3 = wstar3 + bprod(i,pver+1) * dzhb
2336 end if
233747773604777360 wstar3 = max( 2.5_r8 * wstar3, 0._r8 )
2338
2339 ! -------------------------------------------------------------- !
2340 ! Below single block is for 'sedimentation-entrainment feedback' !
2341 ! -------------------------------------------------------------- !
2342
2343 if( id_sedfact ) then
2344 ! wsed = 7.8e5_r8*(ql(i,kt)/ncliq(i,kt))**(2._r8/3._r8)
234500 sedfact = exp(-ased*wsedl(i,kt)/(wstar3**(1._r8/3._r8)+1.e-6_r8))
2346 wsed_CL(i,ncv) = wsedl(i,kt)
234700 if( choice_evhc .eq. 'orig' ) then
234800 if (ql(i,kt).gt.qmin .and. ql(i,kt-1).lt.qmin) then
234900 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2350 jt2slv = max(jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g)
2351 evhc = 1._r8+sedfact*a2l*a3l*latvap*ql(i,kt) / jt2slv
2352 evhc = min(evhc,evhcmax)
2353 end if
235400 elseif( choice_evhc .eq. 'ramp' ) then
235500 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2356 jt2slv = max(jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g)
2357 evhc = 1._r8+max(cldeff(i,kt)-cldeff(i,kt-1),0._r8)*sedfact*a2l*a3l*latvap*ql(i,kt) / jt2slv
2358 evhc = min(evhc,evhcmax)
235900 elseif( choice_evhc .eq. 'maxi' ) then
236000 qleff = max(ql(i,kt-1),ql(i,kt))
2361 jt2slv = slv(i,max(kt-2,1)) - slv(i,kt)
2362 jt2slv = max(jt2slv, jbumin*slv(i,kt-1)/g)
2363 evhc = 1._r8+sedfact*a2l*a3l*latvap*qleff / jt2slv
2364 evhc = min(evhc,evhcmax)
2365 endif
2366 endif

2368 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2369 ! Now diagnose CL top and bottom entrainment rates (and the contribution of !
2370 ! top/bottom entrainments to wstar3) using entrainment closures of the form !
2371 ! !
2372 ! wet = cet*wstar3, web = ceb*wstar3 !
2373 ! !
2374 ! where cet and ceb depend on the entrainment interface jumps, ql, etc. !
2375 ! No entrainment is diagnosed unless the wstar3 > 0. Note '1/wstar3fact' is !
2376 ! a factor indicating the enhancement of wstar3 due to entrainment process. !
2377 ! Q : Below setting of 'wstar3fact = max(..,0.5)'might prevent the possible !
2378 ! case when buoyancy consumption by entrainment is stronger than cloud !
2379 ! top radiative cooling production. Is that OK ? No. According to bulk !
2380 ! modeling study, entrainment buoyancy consumption was always a certain !
2381 ! fraction of other net productions, rather than a separate sum. Thus, !
2382 ! below max limit of wstar3fact is correct. 'wstar3fact = max(.,0.5)' !
2383 ! prevents unreasonable enhancement of CL entrainment rate by cloud-top !
2384 ! entrainment instability, CTEI. !
2385 ! Q : Use of the same dry entrainment coefficient, 'a1i' both at the CL top !
2386 ! and base interfaces may result in too small 'wstar3' and 'ebrk' below, !
2387 ! as was seen in my generalized bulk modeling study. This should be re- !
2388 ! considered later !
2389 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2390
239147773604777360 if( wstar3 .gt. 0._r8 ) then
239247716974771697 cet = a1i * evhc / ( jtbu * lbulk )
2393 if( kb .eq. pver + 1 ) then
239426797992679799 wstar3fact = max( 1._r8 + 2.5_r8 * cet * n2ht * jtzm * dzht, wstar3factcrit )
2395 else
239620918982091898 ceb = a1i / ( jbbu * lbulk )
2397 wstar3fact = max( 1._r8 + 2.5_r8 * cet * n2ht * jtzm * dzht &
2398 + 2.5_r8 * ceb * n2hb * jbzm * dzhb, wstar3factcrit )
2399 end if
240047716974771697 wstar3 = wstar3 / wstar3fact
2401 else ! wstar3 == 0
240256635663 wstar3fact = 0._r8 ! This is just for dianostic output
2403 cet = 0._r8
2404 ceb = 0._r8
2405 end if
2406
2407 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2408 ! Calculate net CL mean TKE including entrainment contribution by solving a !
2409 ! canonical cubic equation. The solution of cubic equ. is 'rootp**2 = ebrk' !
2410 ! where 'ebrk' originally (before solving cubic eq.) was interior CL mean TKE, !
2411 ! but after solving cubic equation, it is replaced by net CL mean TKE in the !
2412 ! same variable 'ebrk'. !
2413 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2414 ! Solve cubic equation (canonical form for analytic solution) !
2415 ! r^3 - 3*trmp*r - 2*trmq = 0, r = sqrt<e> !
2416 ! to estimate <e> for CL, derived from layer-mean TKE balance: !
2417 ! !
2418 ! <e>^(3/2)/(b_1*<l>) \approx <B + S> (*) !
2419 ! <B+S> = (<B+S>_int * l_int + <B+S>_et * dzt + <B+S>_eb * dzb)/lbulk !
2420 ! <B+S>_int = <e>^(1/2)/(b_1*<l>)*<e>_int !
2421 ! <B+S>_et = (-vyt+vut)*wet*jtbu + radf !
2422 ! <B+S>_eb = (-vyb+vub)*web*jbbu !
2423 ! !
2424 ! where: !
2425 ! <> denotes a vertical avg (over the whole CL unless indicated) !
2426 ! l_int (called lbrk below) is aggregate thickness of interior CL layers !
2427 ! dzt = zi(i,kt)-z(i,kt) is thickness of top entrainment layer !
2428 ! dzb = z(i,kb-1)-zi(i,kb) is thickness of bot entrainment layer !
2429 ! <e>_int (called ebrk below) is the CL-mean TKE if only interior !
2430 ! interfaces contributed. !
2431 ! wet, web are top. bottom entrainment rates !
2432 ! !
2433 ! For a single-level radiatively-driven convective layer, there are no !
2434 ! interior interfaces so 'ebrk' = 'lbrk' = 0. If the CL goes to the !
2435 ! surface, 'vyb' and 'vub' are set to zero before and 'ebrk' and 'lbrk' !
2436 ! have already incorporated the surface interfacial layer contribution, !
2437 ! so the same formulas still apply. !
2438 ! !
2439 ! In the original formulation based on TKE, !
2440 ! wet*jtbu = a1l*evhc*<e>^3/2/leng(i,kt) !
2441 ! web*jbbu = a1l*<e>^3/2/leng(i,kt) !
2442 ! !
2443 ! In the wstar formulation !
2444 ! wet*jtbu = a1i*evhc*wstar3/lbulk !
2445 ! web*jbbu = a1i*wstar3/lbulk, !
2446 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2447
244847773604777360 fact = ( evhc * ( -vyt + vut ) * dzht + ( -vyb + vub ) * dzhb * leng(i,kb) / leng(i,kt) ) / lbulk
2449
2450 if( wstarent ) then
2451
2452 ! (Option 1) 'wstar' entrainment formulation
2453 ! Here trmq can have either sign, and will usually be nonzero even for non-
2454 ! cloud topped CLs. If trmq > 0, there will be two positive roots r; we take
2455 ! the larger one. Why ? If necessary, we limit entrainment and wstar to prevent
2456 ! a solution with r < ccrit*wstar ( Why ? ) where we take ccrit = 0.5.
2457
245847773604777360 trma = 1._r8
2459 trmp = ebrk(i,ncv) * ( lbrk(i,ncv) / lbulk ) / 3._r8 + ntzero
2460 trmq = 0.5_r8 * b1 * ( leng(i,kt) / lbulk ) * ( radf * dzht + a1i * fact * wstar3 )
2461
2462 ! Check if there is an acceptable root with r > rcrit = ccrit*wstar.
2463 ! To do this, first find local minimum fmin of the cubic f(r) at sqrt(p),
2464 ! and value fcrit = f(rcrit).
2465
246647773604777360 rmin = sqrt(trmp)
2467 fmin = rmin * ( rmin * rmin - 3._r8 * trmp ) - 2._r8 * trmq
246847773609554720 wstar = wstar3**onet
2469 rcrit = ccrit * wstar
2470 fcrit = rcrit * ( rcrit * rcrit - 3._r8 * trmp ) - 2._r8 * trmq
2471
2472 ! No acceptable root exists (noroot = .true.) if either:
2473 ! 1) rmin < rcrit (in which case cubic is monotone increasing for r > rcrit)
2474 ! and f(rcrit) > 0.
2475 ! or 2) rmin > rcrit (in which case min of f(r) in r > rcrit is at rmin)
2476 ! and f(rmin) > 0.
2477 ! In this case, we reduce entrainment and wstar3 such that r/wstar = ccrit;
2478 ! this changes the coefficients of the cubic. It might be informative to
2479 ! check when and how many 'noroot' cases occur, since when 'noroot', we
2480 ! will impose arbitrary limit on 'wstar3, wet, web, and ebrk' using ccrit.
2481
2482477736023886800 noroot = ( ( rmin .lt. rcrit ) .and. ( fcrit .gt. 0._r8 ) ) &
2483477736014332080 .or. ( ( rmin .ge. rcrit ) .and. ( fmin .gt. 0._r8 ) )
2484 if( noroot ) then ! Solve cubic for r
2485259384259384 trma = 1._r8 - b1 * ( leng(i,kt) / lbulk ) * a1i * fact / ccrit**3
2486 trma = max( trma, 0.5_r8 ) ! Limit entrainment enhancement of ebrk
2487 trmp = trmp / trma
2488 trmq = 0.5_r8 * b1 * ( leng(i,kt) / lbulk ) * radf * dzht / trma
2489 end if ! noroot
2490
2491 ! Solve the cubic equation
2492
249347773609554720 qq = trmq**2 - trmp**3
2494 if( qq .ge. 0._r8 ) then
249518155019077505 rootp = ( trmq + sqrt(qq) )**(1._r8/3._r8) + ( max( trmq - sqrt(qq), 0._r8 ) )**(1._r8/3._r8)
2496 else
2497296185914809295 rootp = 2._r8 * sqrt(trmp) * cos( acos( trmq / sqrt(trmp**3) ) / 3._r8 )
2498 end if
2499
2500 ! Adjust 'wstar3' only if there is 'noroot'.
2501 ! And calculate entrainment rates at the top and base interfaces.
2502
250347773605036744 if( noroot ) wstar3 = ( rootp / ccrit )**3 ! Adjust wstar3
250447773604777360 wet = cet * wstar3 ! Find entrainment rates
250520974692097469 if( kb .lt. pver + 1 ) web = ceb * wstar3 ! When 'kb.eq.pver+1', it was set to web=0.
2506
2507 else !
2508
2509 ! (Option.2) wstarentr = .false. Use original entrainment formulation.
2510 ! trmp > 0 if there are interior interfaces in CL, trmp = 0 otherwise.
2511 ! trmq > 0 if there is cloudtop radiative cooling, trmq = 0 otherwise.
2512
251300 trma = 1._r8 - b1 * a1l * fact
2514 trma = max( trma, 0.5_r8 ) ! Prevents runaway entrainment instability
2515 trmp = ebrk(i,ncv) * ( lbrk(i,ncv) / lbulk ) / ( 3._r8 * trma )
2516 trmq = 0.5_r8 * b1 * ( leng(i,kt) / lbulk ) * radf * dzht / trma
2517
251800 qq = trmq**2 - trmp**3
2519 if( qq .ge. 0._r8 ) then
252000 rootp = ( trmq + sqrt(qq) )**(1._r8/3._r8) + ( max( trmq - sqrt(qq), 0._r8 ) )**(1._r8/3._r8)
2521 else ! Also part of case 3
252200 rootp = 2._r8 * sqrt(trmp) * cos( acos( trmq / sqrt(trmp**3) ) / 3._r8 )
2523 end if ! qq
2524
2525 ! Find entrainment rates and limit them by free-entrainment values a1l*sqrt(e)
2526
252700 wet = a1l * rootp * min( evhc * rootp**2 / ( leng(i,kt) * jtbu ), 1._r8 )
252800 if( kb .lt. pver + 1 ) web = a1l * rootp * min( evhc * rootp**2 / ( leng(i,kb) * jbbu ), 1._r8 )
2529
2530 end if ! wstarentr
2531
2532 ! ---------------------------------------------------- !
2533 ! Finally, get the net CL mean TKE and normalized TKE !
2534 ! ---------------------------------------------------- !
2535
253647773604777360 ebrk(i,ncv) = rootp**2
2537 ebrk(i,ncv) = min(ebrk(i,ncv),tkemax) ! Limit CL-avg TKE used for entrainment
2538 wbrk(i,ncv) = ebrk(i,ncv)/b1
2539
2540 ! The only way ebrk = 0 is for SRCL which are actually radiatively cooled
2541 ! at top interface. In this case, we remove 'convective' label from the
2542 ! interfaces around this layer. This case should now be impossible, so
2543 ! we flag it. Q: I can't understand why this case is impossible now. Maybe,
2544 ! due to various limiting procedures used in solving cubic equation ?
2545 ! In case of SRCL, 'ebrk' should be positive due to cloud top LW radiative
2546 ! cooling contribution, although 'ebrk(internal)' of SRCL before including
2547 ! entrainment contribution (which include LW cooling contribution also) is
2548 ! zero.
2549
2550 if( ebrk(i,ncv) .le. 0._r8 ) then
255100 write(iulog,*) 'CALEDDY: Warning, CL with zero TKE, i, kt, kb ', i, kt, kb
255200 belongcv(i,kt) = .false.
2553 belongcv(i,kb) = .false.
2554 end if
2555
2556 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2557 ! Calculate complete TKE profiles at all CL interfaces, capped by tkemax. !
2558 ! We approximate TKE = <e> at entrainment interfaces. However when CL is !
2559 ! based at surface, correct 'tkes' will be inserted to tke(i,pver+1). !
2560 ! Note that this approximation at CL external interfaces do not influence !
2561 ! numerical calculation since 'e' at external interfaces are not used in !
2562 ! actual numerical calculation afterward. In addition in order to extract !
2563 ! correct TKE averaged over the PBL in the cumulus scheme,it is necessary !
2564 ! to set e = <e> at the top entrainment interface. Since net CL mean TKE !
2565 ! 'ebrk' obtained by solving cubic equation already includes tkes ( tkes !
2566 ! is included when bflxs > 0 but not when bflxs <= 0 into internal ebrk ),!
2567 ! 'tkes' should be written to tke(i,pver+1) !
2568 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2569
2570 ! 1. At internal interfaces
2571601610710793467 do k = kb - 1, kt + 1, -1
257260161076016107 rcap = ( b1 * ae + wcap(i,k) / wbrk(i,ncv) ) / ( b1 * ae + 1._r8 )
2573 rcap = min( max(rcap,rcapmin), rcapmax )
2574 tke(i,k) = ebrk(i,ncv) * rcap
2575 tke(i,k) = min( tke(i,k), tkemax )
257660161076016107 kvh(i,k) = leng(i,k) * sqrt(tke(i,k)) * shcl(i,ncv)
2577 kvm(i,k) = leng(i,k) * sqrt(tke(i,k)) * smcl(i,ncv)
2578 bprod(i,k) = -kvh(i,k) * n2(i,k)
2579 sprod(i,k) = kvm(i,k) * s2(i,k)
2580 turbtype(i,k) = 2 ! CL interior interfaces.
2581 sm_aw(i,k) = smcl(i,ncv)/alph1 ! Diagnostic output for microphysics
2582 end do
2583
2584 ! 2. At CL top entrainment interface
258547773604777360 kentr = wet * jtzm
2586 kvh(i,kt) = kentr
2587 kvm(i,kt) = kentr
2588 bprod(i,kt) = -kentr * n2ht + radf ! I must use 'n2ht' not 'n2'
2589 sprod(i,kt) = kentr * s2(i,kt)
2590 turbtype(i,kt) = 4 ! CL top entrainment interface
2591 trmp = -b1 * ae / ( 1._r8 + b1 * ae )
259247773609554720 trmq = -(bprod(i,kt)+sprod(i,kt))*b1*leng(i,kt)/(1._r8+b1*ae)/(ebrk(i,ncv)**(3._r8/2._r8))
259347773609554720 rcap = compute_cubic(0._r8,trmp,trmq)**2._r8
2594 rcap = min( max(rcap,rcapmin), rcapmax )
2595 tke(i,kt) = ebrk(i,ncv) * rcap
2596 tke(i,kt) = min( tke(i,kt), tkemax )
2597 sm_aw(i,kt) = smcl(i,ncv) / alph1 ! Diagnostic output for microphysics
2598
2599 ! 3. At CL base entrainment interface and double entraining interfaces
2600 ! When current CL base is also the top interface of CL regime below,
2601 ! simply add the two contributions for calculating eddy diffusivity
2602 ! and buoyancy/shear production. Below code correctly works because
2603 ! we (CL regime index) always go from surface upward.
2604
2605 if( kb .lt. pver + 1 ) then
2606
260720974692097469 kentr = web * jbzm
2608
2609 if( kb .ne. ktblw ) then
2610
261119380861938086 kvh(i,kb) = kentr
2612 kvm(i,kb) = kentr
2613 bprod(i,kb) = -kvh(i,kb)*n2hb ! I must use 'n2hb' not 'n2'
2614 sprod(i,kb) = kvm(i,kb)*s2(i,kb)
2615 turbtype(i,kb) = 3 ! CL base entrainment interface
2616 trmp = -b1*ae/(1._r8+b1*ae)
261719380863876172 trmq = -(bprod(i,kb)+sprod(i,kb))*b1*leng(i,kb)/(1._r8+b1*ae)/(ebrk(i,ncv)**(3._r8/2._r8))
261819380863876172 rcap = compute_cubic(0._r8,trmp,trmq)**2._r8
2619 rcap = min( max(rcap,rcapmin), rcapmax )
2620 tke(i,kb) = ebrk(i,ncv) * rcap
2621 tke(i,kb) = min( tke(i,kb),tkemax )
2622
2623 else
2624
2625159383159383 kvh(i,kb) = kvh(i,kb) + kentr
2626 kvm(i,kb) = kvm(i,kb) + kentr
2627 ! dzhb5 : Half thickness of the lowest layer of current CL regime
2628 ! dzht5 : Half thickness of the highest layer of adjacent CL regime just below current CL.
2629 dzhb5 = z(i,kb-1) - zi(i,kb)
2630 dzht5 = zi(i,kb) - z(i,kb)
2631 bprod(i,kb) = ( dzht5*bprod(i,kb) - dzhb5*kentr*n2hb ) / ( dzhb5 + dzht5 )
2632 sprod(i,kb) = ( dzht5*sprod(i,kb) + dzhb5*kentr*s2(i,kb) ) / ( dzhb5 + dzht5 )
2633 trmp = -b1*ae/(1._r8+b1*ae)
2634159383318766 trmq = -kentr*(s2(i,kb)-n2hb)*b1*leng(i,kb)/(1._r8+b1*ae)/(ebrk(i,ncv)**(3._r8/2._r8))
2635159383318766 rcap = compute_cubic(0._r8,trmp,trmq)**2._r8
2636 rcap = min( max(rcap,rcapmin), rcapmax )
2637 tke_imsi = ebrk(i,ncv) * rcap
2638 tke_imsi = min( tke_imsi, tkemax )
2639 tke(i,kb) = ( dzht5*tke(i,kb) + dzhb5*tke_imsi ) / ( dzhb5 + dzht5 )
2640 tke(i,kb) = min(tke(i,kb),tkemax)
2641 turbtype(i,kb) = 5 ! CL double entraining interface
2642
2643 end if
2644
2645 else
2646
2647 ! If CL base interface is surface, compute similarly using wcap(i,kb)=tkes/b1
2648 ! Even when bflx < 0, use the same formula in order to impose consistency of
2649 ! tke(i,kb) at bflx = 0._r8
2650
265126798912679891 rcap = (b1*ae + wcap(i,kb)/wbrk(i,ncv))/(b1*ae + 1._r8)
2652 rcap = min( max(rcap,rcapmin), rcapmax )
2653 tke(i,kb) = ebrk(i,ncv) * rcap
2654 tke(i,kb) = min( tke(i,kb),tkemax )
2655
2656 end if
2657
2658 ! For double entraining interface, simply use smcl(i,ncv) of the overlying CL.
2659 ! Below 'sm_aw' is a diagnostic output for use in the microphysics.
2660 ! When 'kb' is surface, 'sm' will be over-written later below.
2661
266247773604777360 sm_aw(i,kb) = smcl(i,ncv)/alph1
2663
2664 ! Calculate wcap at all interfaces of CL. Put a minimum threshold on TKE
2665 ! to prevent possible division by zero. 'wcap' at CL internal interfaces
2666 ! are already calculated in the first part of 'do ncv' loop correctly.
2667 ! When 'kb.eq.pver+1', below formula produces the identical result to the
2668 ! 'tkes(i)/b1' if leng(i,kb) is set to vk*z(i,pver). Note wcap(i,pver+1)
2669 ! is already defined as 'tkes(i)/b1' at the first part of caleddy.
2670
267147773604777360 wcap(i,kt) = (bprod(i,kt)+sprod(i,kt))*leng(i,kt)/sqrt(max(tke(i,kt),1.e-6_r8))
2672 if( kb .lt. pver + 1 ) then
267320974692097469 wcap(i,kb) = (bprod(i,kb)+sprod(i,kb))*leng(i,kb)/sqrt(max(tke(i,kb),1.e-6_r8))
2674 end if
2675
2676 ! Save the index of upper external interface of current CL-regime in order to
2677 ! handle the case when this interface is also the lower external interface of
2678 ! CL-regime located just above.
2679
2680 ktblw = kt
2681
2682 ! Diagnostic Output
2683
2684 wet_CL(i,ncv) = wet
2685 web_CL(i,ncv) = web
2686 jtbu_CL(i,ncv) = jtbu
2687 jbbu_CL(i,ncv) = jbbu
2688 evhc_CL(i,ncv) = evhc
2689 jt2slv_CL(i,ncv) = jt2slv
2690 n2ht_CL(i,ncv) = n2ht
2691 n2hb_CL(i,ncv) = n2hb
2692 wstar_CL(i,ncv) = wstar
2693 wstar3fact_CL(i,ncv) = wstar3fact
2694
2695 end do ! ncv
2696
2697 ! Calculate PBL height and characteristic cumulus excess for use in the
2698 ! cumulus convection shceme. Also define turbulence type at the surface
2699 ! when the lowest CL is based at the surface. These are just diagnostic
2700 ! outputs, not influencing numerical calculation of current PBL scheme.
2701 ! If the lowest CL is based at the surface, define the PBL depth as the
2702 ! CL top interface. The same rule is applied for all CLs including SRCL.
2703
270435256303525630 if( ncvsurf .gt. 0 ) then
2705
270626798912679891 ktopbl(i) = ktop(i,ncvsurf)
2707 pblh(i) = zi(i, ktopbl(i))
2708 pblhp(i) = pi(i, ktopbl(i))
270926798912679891 wpert(i) = max(wfac*sqrt(ebrk(i,ncvsurf)),wpertmin)
2710 tpert(i) = max(abs(shflx(i)*rrho(i)/cpair)*tfac/wpert(i),0._r8)
2711 qpert(i) = max(abs(qflx(i)*rrho(i))*tfac/wpert(i),0._r8)
2712
2713 if( bflxs(i) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
271426253442625344 turbtype(i,pver+1) = 2 ! CL interior interface
2715 else
27165454754547 turbtype(i,pver+1) = 3 ! CL external base interface
2717 endif
2718
271926798912679891 ipbl(i) = 1
2720 kpblh(i) = max(ktopbl(i)-1, 1)
2721 went(i) = wet_CL(i,ncvsurf)
2722 end if ! End of the calculationf of te properties of surface-based CL.
2723
2724 ! -------------------------------------------- !
2725 ! Treatment of Stable Turbulent Regime ( STL ) !
2726 ! -------------------------------------------- !
2727
2728 ! Identify top and bottom most (internal) interfaces of STL except surface.
2729 ! Also, calculate 'turbulent length scale (leng)' at each STL interfaces.
2730
273135256303525630 belongst(i,1) = .false. ! k = 1 (top interface) is assumed non-turbulent
2732102243270102243270 do k = 2, pver ! k is an interface index
2733102243270306729810 belongst(i,k) = ( ri(i,k) .lt. ricrit ) .and. ( .not. belongcv(i,k) )
273411607841160784 if( belongst(i,k) .and. ( .not. belongst(i,k-1) ) ) then
2735756631756631 kt = k ! Top interface index of STL
2736101486639202569125 elseif( .not. belongst(i,k) .and. belongst(i,k-1) ) then
2737336831336831 kb = k - 1 ! Base interface index of STL
2738 lbulk = z(i,kt-1) - z(i,kb)
2739 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
2740403055403055 do ks = kt, kb
2741403055403055 if( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampcl' ) then
2742403055403055 tunlramp = tunl
274300 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then
274400 tunlramp = max( 1.e-3_r8, ctunl * tunl * exp(-log(ctunl)*ri(i,ks)/ricrit) )
2745 ! tunlramp = 0.065_r8 + 0.7_r8 * exp(-20._r8*ri(i,ks))
2746 else
274700 tunlramp = tunl
2748 endif
2749403055403055 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then
27504030551612220 leng(i,ks) = ( (vk*zi(i,ks))**(-cleng) + (tunlramp*lbulk)**(-cleng) )**(-1._r8/cleng)
2751 ! leng(i,ks) = vk*zi(i,ks) / (1._r8+vk*zi(i,ks)/(tunlramp*lbulk))
2752 else
275300 leng(i,ks) = min( vk*zi(i,ks), tunlramp*lbulk )
2754 endif
2755 leng(i,ks) = min(leng_max(ks), leng(i,ks))
2756 end do
2757 end if
2758 end do ! k
2759
2760 ! Now look whether STL extends to ground. If STL extends to surface,
2761 ! re-define master length scale,'lbulk' including surface interfacial
2762 ! layer thickness, and re-calculate turbulent length scale, 'leng' at
2763 ! all STL interfaces again. Note that surface interface is assumed to
2764 ! always be STL if it is not CL.
2765
276635256303525630 belongst(i,pver+1) = .not. belongcv(i,pver+1)
2767
2768 if( belongst(i,pver+1) ) then ! kb = pver+1 (surface STL)
2769
2770845739845739 turbtype(i,pver+1) = 1 ! Surface is STL interface
2771
2772 if( belongst(i,pver) ) then ! STL includes interior
2773 ! 'kt' already defined above as the top interface of STL
2774419800419800 lbulk = z(i,kt-1)
2775 else ! STL with no interior turbulence
2776425939425939 kt = pver+1
2777 lbulk = z(i,kt-1)
2778 end if
2779845739845739 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
2780
2781 ! PBL height : Layer mid-point just above the highest STL interface
2782 ! Note in contrast to the surface based CL regime where PBL height
2783 ! was defined at the top external interface, PBL height of surface
2784 ! based STL is defined as the layer mid-point.
2785
2786 ktopbl(i) = kt - 1
2787 pblh(i) = z(i,ktopbl(i))
2788 pblhp(i) = 0.5_r8 * ( pi(i,ktopbl(i)) + pi(i,ktopbl(i)+1) )
2789
2790 ! Re-calculate turbulent length scale including surface interfacial
2791 ! layer contribution to lbulk.
2792
2793757729757729 do ks = kt, pver
2794757729757729 if( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampcl' ) then
2795757729757729 tunlramp = tunl
279600 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then
279700 tunlramp = max(1.e-3_r8,ctunl*tunl*exp(-log(ctunl)*ri(i,ks)/ricrit))
2798 ! tunlramp = 0.065_r8 + 0.7_r8 * exp(-20._r8*ri(i,ks))
2799 else
280000 tunlramp = tunl
2801 endif
2802757729757729 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then
28037577293030916 leng(i,ks) = ( (vk*zi(i,ks))**(-cleng) + (tunlramp*lbulk)**(-cleng) )**(-1._r8/cleng)
2804 ! leng(i,ks) = vk*zi(i,ks) / (1._r8+vk*zi(i,ks)/(tunlramp*lbulk))
2805 else
280600 leng(i,ks) = min( vk*zi(i,ks), tunlramp*lbulk )
2807 endif
2808 leng(i,ks) = min(leng_max(ks), leng(i,ks))
2809 end do ! ks
2810
2811 ! Characteristic cumulus excess of surface-based STL.
2812 ! We may be able to use ustar for wpert.
2813
2814845739845739 wpert(i) = 0._r8
2815 tpert(i) = max(shflx(i)*rrho(i)/cpair*fak/ustar(i),0._r8) ! CCM stable-layer forms
2816 qpert(i) = max(qflx(i)*rrho(i)*fak/ustar(i),0._r8)
2817
2818 ipbl(i) = 0
2819 kpblh(i) = ktopbl(i)
2820
2821 end if
2822
2823 ! Calculate stability functions and energetics at the STL interfaces
2824 ! except the surface. Note that tke(i,pver+1) and wcap(i,pver+1) are
2825 ! already calculated in the first part of 'caleddy', kvm(i,pver+1) &
2826 ! kvh(i,pver+1) were already initialized to be zero, bprod(i,pver+1)
2827 ! & sprod(i,pver+1) were direcly calculated from the bflxs and ustar.
2828 ! Note transport term is assumed to be negligible at STL interfaces.
2829
2830102243270105768900 do k = 2, pver
2831
2832102243270102243270 if( belongst(i,k) ) then
2833
283411607841160784 turbtype(i,k) = 1 ! STL interfaces
2835 trma = alph3*alph4exs*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(alph2-alph4exs*alph5*ri(i,k))
2836 trmb = (alph3+alph4exs)*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(-alph5*ri(i,k)+alph1)
2837 trmc = ri(i,k)
2838 det = max(trmb*trmb-4._r8*trma*trmc,0._r8)
2839 ! Sanity Check
2840 if( det .lt. 0._r8 ) then
284100 write(iulog,*) 'The det < 0. for the STL in UW eddy_diff'
284200 call endrun('CALEDDY: The det < 0. for the STL in UW eddy_diff')
2843 end if
284411607841160784 gh = (-trmb + sqrt(det))/(2._r8*trma)
2845 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
2846 ! gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
2847 gh = min(max(gh,ghmin),0.0233_r8)
2848 sh = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
2849 sm = max(0._r8,(alph1 + alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4exs*gh))
2850
2851 tke(i,k) = b1*(leng(i,k)**2)*(-sh*n2(i,k)+sm*s2(i,k))
2852 tke(i,k) = min(tke(i,k),tkemax)
2853 wcap(i,k) = tke(i,k)/b1
285411607841160784 kvh(i,k) = leng(i,k) * sqrt(tke(i,k)) * sh
285511607841160784 kvm(i,k) = leng(i,k) * sqrt(tke(i,k)) * sm
2856 bprod(i,k) = -kvh(i,k) * n2(i,k)
2857 sprod(i,k) = kvm(i,k) * s2(i,k)
2858
2859 sm_aw(i,k) = sm/alph1 ! This is diagnostic output for use in the microphysics
2860
2861 end if
2862
2863 end do ! k
2864
2865 ! --------------------------------------------------- !
2866 ! End of treatment of Stable Turbulent Regime ( STL ) !
2867 ! --------------------------------------------------- !
2868
2869 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
2870 ! Re-computation of eddy diffusivity at the entrainment interface !
2871 ! assuming that it is purely STL (0<Ri<0.19). Note even Ri>0.19, !
2872 ! turbulent can exist at the entrainment interface since 'Sh,Sm' !
2873 ! do not necessarily go to zero even when Ri>0.19. Since Ri can !
2874 ! be fairly larger than 0.19 at the entrainment interface, I !
2875 ! should set minimum value of 'tke' to be 0. in order to prevent !
2876 ! sqrt(tke) from being imaginary. !
2877 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
2878
2879 ! goto 888
2880
2881102243270105768900 do k = 2, pver
2882
2883102243270298269343 if( ( turbtype(i,k) .eq. 3 ) .or. ( turbtype(i,k) .eq. 4 ) .or. &
2884 ( turbtype(i,k) .eq. 5 ) ) then
2885
288666986056698605 trma = alph3*alph4exs*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(alph2-alph4exs*alph5*ri(i,k))
2887 trmb = (alph3+alph4exs)*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(-alph5*ri(i,k)+alph1)
2888 trmc = ri(i,k)
2889 det = max(trmb*trmb-4._r8*trma*trmc,0._r8)
289066986056698605 gh = (-trmb + sqrt(det))/(2._r8*trma)
2891 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
2892 ! gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
2893 gh = min(max(gh,ghmin),0.0233_r8)
2894 sh = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
2895 sm = max(0._r8,(alph1 + alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4exs*gh))
2896
2897 lbulk = z(i,k-1) - z(i,k)
2898 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
2899
290066986056698605 if( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampcl' ) then
290166986056698605 tunlramp = tunl
290200 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then
290300 tunlramp = max(1.e-3_r8,ctunl*tunl*exp(-log(ctunl)*ri(i,k)/ricrit))
2904 ! tunlramp = 0.065_r8 + 0.7_r8*exp(-20._r8*ri(i,k))
2905 else
290600 tunlramp = tunl
2907 endif
290866986056698605 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then
2909669860526794420 leng_imsi = ( (vk*zi(i,k))**(-cleng) + (tunlramp*lbulk)**(-cleng) )**(-1._r8/cleng)
2910 ! leng_imsi = vk*zi(i,k) / (1._r8+vk*zi(i,k)/(tunlramp*lbulk))
2911 else
291200 leng_imsi = min( vk*zi(i,k), tunlramp*lbulk )
2913 endif
291466986056698605 leng_imsi = min(leng_max(k), leng_imsi)
2915
2916 tke_imsi = b1*(leng_imsi**2)*(-sh*n2(i,k)+sm*s2(i,k))
2917 tke_imsi = min(max(tke_imsi,0._r8),tkemax)
291866986056698605 kvh_imsi = leng_imsi * sqrt(tke_imsi) * sh
291966986056698605 kvm_imsi = leng_imsi * sqrt(tke_imsi) * sm
2920
2921 if( kvh(i,k) .lt. kvh_imsi ) then
2922702272702272 kvh(i,k) = kvh_imsi
2923 kvm(i,k) = kvm_imsi
2924 leng(i,k) = leng_imsi
2925 tke(i,k) = tke_imsi
2926 wcap(i,k) = tke_imsi / b1
2927 bprod(i,k) = -kvh_imsi * n2(i,k)
2928 sprod(i,k) = kvm_imsi * s2(i,k)
2929 sm_aw(i,k) = sm/alph1 ! This is diagnostic output for use in the microphysics
2930 turbtype(i,k) = 1 ! This was added on Dec.10.2009 for use in microphysics.
2931 endif
2932
2933 end if
2934
2935 end do
2936
2937 ! 888 continue
2938
2939 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
2940 ! End of recomputation of eddy diffusivity at entrainment interfaces !
2941 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
2942
2943 ! As an option, we can impose a certain minimum back-ground diffusivity.
2944
2945 ! do k = 1, pver+1
2946 ! kvh(i,k) = max(0.01_r8,kvh(i,k))
2947 ! kvm(i,k) = max(0.01_r8,kvm(i,k))
2948 ! enddo
2949
2950 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2951 ! Diagnostic Output !
2952 ! Just for diagnostic purpose, calculate stability functions at each !
2953 ! interface including surface. Instead of assuming neutral stability, !
2954 ! explicitly calculate stability functions using an reverse procedure !
2955 ! starting from tkes(i) similar to the case of SRCL and SBCL in zisocl. !
2956 ! Note that it is possible to calculate stability functions even when !
2957 ! bflxs < 0. Note that this inverse method allows us to define Ri even !
2958 ! at the surface. Note also tkes(i) and sprod(i,pver+1) are always !
2959 ! positive values by limiters (e.g., ustar_min = 0.01). !
2960 ! Dec.12.2006 : Also just for diagnostic output, re-set !
2961 ! 'bprod(i,pver+1)= bflxs(i)' here. Note that this setting does not !
2962 ! influence numerical calculation at all - it is just for diagnostic !
2963 ! output. !
2964 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2965
296635256303525630 bprod(i,pver+1) = bflxs(i)
2967
296835256307051260 gg = 0.5_r8*vk*z(i,pver)*bprod(i,pver+1)/(tkes(i)**(3._r8/2._r8))
2969 if( abs(alph5-gg*alph3) .le. 1.e-7_r8 ) then
2970 ! gh = -0.28_r8
297100 if( bprod(i,pver+1) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
297200 gh = -3.5334_r8
2973 else
297400 gh = ghmin
2975 endif
2976 else
297735256303525630 gh = gg/(alph5-gg*alph3)
2978 end if
2979
2980 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
298135256303525630 if( bprod(i,pver+1) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
298226253442625344 gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
2983 else
2984900286900286 gh = min(max(gh,ghmin),0.0233_r8)
2985 endif
2986
298735256303525630 gh_a(i,pver+1) = gh
2988 sh_a(i,pver+1) = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
2989 if( bprod(i,pver+1) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
299026253442625344 sm_a(i,pver+1) = max(0._r8,(alph1+alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4*gh))
2991 else
2992900286900286 sm_a(i,pver+1) = max(0._r8,(alph1+alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4exs*gh))
2993 endif
299435256303525630 sm_aw(i,pver+1) = sm_a(i,pver+1)/alph1
2995 ri_a(i,pver+1) = -(sm_a(i,pver+1)/sh_a(i,pver+1))*(bprod(i,pver+1)/sprod(i,pver+1))
2996
2997105768900105768900 do k = 1, pver
2998105768900105768900 if( ri(i,k) .lt. 0._r8 ) then
299958920935892093 trma = alph3*alph4*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(alph2-alph4*alph5*ri(i,k))
3000 trmb = (alph3+alph4)*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(-alph5*ri(i,k)+alph1)
3001 trmc = ri(i,k)
3002 det = max(trmb*trmb-4._r8*trma*trmc,0._r8)
300358920935892093 gh = (-trmb + sqrt(det))/(2._r8*trma)
3004 gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
3005 gh_a(i,k) = gh
3006 sh_a(i,k) = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
3007 sm_a(i,k) = max(0._r8,(alph1+alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4*gh))
3008 ri_a(i,k) = ri(i,k)
3009 else
30109987680799876807 if( ri(i,k) .gt. ricrit ) then
30119807409198074091 gh_a(i,k) = ghmin
3012 sh_a(i,k) = 0._r8
3013 sm_a(i,k) = 0._r8
3014 ri_a(i,k) = ri(i,k)
3015 else
301618027161802716 trma = alph3*alph4exs*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(alph2-alph4exs*alph5*ri(i,k))
3017 trmb = (alph3+alph4exs)*ri(i,k) + 2._r8*b1*(-alph5*ri(i,k)+alph1)
3018 trmc = ri(i,k)
3019 det = max(trmb*trmb-4._r8*trma*trmc,0._r8)
302018027161802716 gh = (-trmb + sqrt(det))/(2._r8*trma)
3021 gh = min(max(gh,ghmin),0.0233_r8)
3022 gh_a(i,k) = gh
3023 sh_a(i,k) = max(0._r8,alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh))
3024 sm_a(i,k) = max(0._r8,(alph1+alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4exs*gh))
3025 ri_a(i,k) = ri(i,k)
3026 endif
3027 endif
3028
3029 end do
3030
3031 end do ! End of column index loop, i
3032
3033 return
3034
3035 end subroutine caleddy
3036
3037 !============================================================================== !
3038 ! !
3039 !============================================================================== !
3040
3041261120522240 subroutine exacol( pcols, pver, ncol, ri, bflxs, minpblh, zi, ktop, kbase, ncvfin )
3042
3043 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3044 ! Object : Find unstable CL regimes and determine the indices !
3045 ! kbase, ktop which delimit these unstable layers : !
3046 ! ri(kbase) > 0 and ri(ktop) > 0, but ri(k) < 0 for ktop < k < kbase. !
3047 ! Author : Chris Bretherton 08/2000, !
3048 ! Sungsu Park 08/2006, 11/2008 !
3049 !----------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3050
3051 implicit none
3052
3053 ! --------------- !
3054 ! Input variables !
3055 ! --------------- !
3056
3057 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
3058 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric vertical layers
3059 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of atmospheric columns
3060
3061 real(r8), intent(in) :: ri(pcols,pver) ! Moist gradient Richardson no.
3062 real(r8), intent(in) :: bflxs(pcols) ! Buoyancy flux at surface
3063 real(r8), intent(in) :: minpblh(pcols) ! Minimum PBL height based on surface stress
3064 real(r8), intent(in) :: zi(pcols,pver+1) ! Interface heights
3065
3066 ! ---------------- !
3067 ! Output variables !
3068 ! ---------------- !
3069
3070 integer, intent(out) :: kbase(pcols,ncvmax) ! External interface index of CL base
3071 integer, intent(out) :: ktop(pcols,ncvmax) ! External interface index of CL top
3072 integer, intent(out) :: ncvfin(pcols) ! Total number of CLs
3073
3074 ! --------------- !
3075 ! Local variables !
3076 ! --------------- !
3077
3078 integer :: i
3079 integer :: k
3080 integer :: ncv
3081 real(r8) :: rimaxentr
3082 real(r8) :: riex(pver+1) ! Column Ri profile extended to surface
3083
3084 ! ----------------------- !
3085 ! Main Computation Begins !
3086 ! ----------------------- !
3087
308835256303525630 do i = 1, ncol
308935256303525630 ncvfin(i) = 0
3090105768900105768900 do ncv = 1, ncvmax
3091 ktop(i,ncv) = 0
3092 kbase(i,ncv) = 0
3093 end do
3094 end do
3095
3096 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3097 ! Find CL regimes starting from the surface going upward !
3098 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3099
3100261120261120 rimaxentr = 0._r8
3101
310235256303525630 do i = 1, ncol
3103
3104102243270109294530 riex(2:pver) = ri(i,2:pver)
3105
3106 ! Below allows consistent treatment of surface and other interfaces.
3107 ! Simply, if surface buoyancy flux is positive, Ri of surface is set to be negative.
3108
310935256303525630 riex(pver+1) = rimaxentr - bflxs(i)
3110
3111 ncv = 0
3112 k = pver + 1 ! Work upward from surface interface
3113
311497086579100612209 do while ( k .gt. ntop_turb + 1 )
3115
3116 ! Below means that if 'bflxs > 0' (do not contain '=' sign), surface
3117 ! interface is energetically interior surface.
3118
31199708657997086579 if( riex(k) .lt. rimaxentr ) then
3120
3121 ! Identify a new CL
3122
312333607463360746 ncv = ncv + 1
3124
3125 ! First define 'kbase' as the first interface below the lower-most unstable interface
3126 ! Thus, Richardson number at 'kbase' is positive.
3127
312833607466721492 kbase(i,ncv) = min(k+1,pver+1)
3129
3130 ! Decrement k until top unstable level
3131
3132851743720395620 do while( riex(k) .lt. rimaxentr .and. k .gt. ntop_turb + 1 )
3133 k = k - 1
3134 end do
3135
3136 ! ktop is the first interface above upper-most unstable interface
3137 ! Thus, Richardson number at 'ktop' is positive.
3138
313933607463360746 ktop(i,ncv) = k
3140
3141 else
3142
3143 ! Search upward for a CL.
3144
31459372583393725833 k = k - 1
3146
3147 end if
3148
3149 end do ! End of CL regime finding for each atmospheric column
3150
3151 ncvfin(i) = ncv
3152
3153 end do ! End of atmospheric column do loop
3154
3155 return
3156
3157 end subroutine exacol
3158
3159 !============================================================================== !
3160 ! !
3161 !============================================================================== !
3162
316328527292852729 subroutine zisocl( pcols , pver , long , &
3164 z , zi , n2 , s2 , &
3165 bprod , sprod , bflxs, tkes , &
3166 ncvfin , kbase , ktop , belongcv, &
3167 ricl , ghcl , shcl , smcl , &
3168 lbrk , wbrk , ebrk , extend , extend_up, extend_dn )
3169
3170 !------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
3171 ! Object : This 'zisocl' vertically extends original CLs identified from !
3172 ! 'exacol' using a merging test based on either 'wint' or 'l2n2' !
3173 ! and identify new CL regimes. Similar to the case of 'exacol', !
3174 ! CL regime index increases with height. After identifying new !
3175 ! CL regimes ( kbase, ktop, ncvfin ),calculate CL internal mean !
3176 ! energetics (lbrk : energetic thickness integral, wbrk, ebrk ) !
3177 ! and stability functions (ricl, ghcl, shcl, smcl) by including !
3178 ! surface interfacial layer contribution when bflxs > 0. Note !
3179 ! that there are two options in the treatment of the energetics !
3180 ! of surface interfacial layer (use_dw_surf= 'true' or 'false') !
3181 ! Author : Sungsu Park 08/2006, 11/2008 !
3182 !------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
3183
3184 implicit none
3185
3186 ! --------------- !
3187 ! Input variables !
3188 ! --------------- !
3189
3190 integer, intent(in) :: long ! Longitude of the column
3191 integer, intent(in) :: pcols ! Number of atmospheric columns
3192 integer, intent(in) :: pver ! Number of atmospheric vertical layers
3193 real(r8), intent(in) :: z(pcols, pver) ! Layer mid-point height [ m ]
3194 real(r8), intent(in) :: zi(pcols, pver+1) ! Interface height [ m ]
3195 real(r8), intent(in) :: n2(pcols, pver) ! Buoyancy frequency at interfaces except surface [ s-2 ]
3196 real(r8), intent(in) :: s2(pcols, pver) ! Shear frequency at interfaces except surface [ s-2 ]
3197 real(r8), intent(in) :: bprod(pcols,pver+1) ! Buoyancy production [ m2/s3 ]. bprod(i,pver+1) = bflxs
3198 real(r8), intent(in) :: sprod(pcols,pver+1) ! Shear production [ m2/s3 ]. sprod(i,pver+1) = usta**3/(vk*z(i,pver))
3199 real(r8), intent(in) :: bflxs(pcols) ! Surface buoyancy flux [ m2/s3 ]. bprod(i,pver+1) = bflxs
3200 real(r8), intent(in) :: tkes(pcols) ! TKE at the surface [ s2/s2 ]
3201
3202 ! ---------------------- !
3203 ! Input/output variables !
3204 ! ---------------------- !
3205
3206 integer, intent(inout) :: kbase(pcols,ncvmax) ! Base external interface index of CL
3207 integer, intent(inout) :: ktop(pcols,ncvmax) ! Top external interface index of CL
3208 integer, intent(inout) :: ncvfin(pcols) ! Total number of CLs
3209
3210 ! ---------------- !
3211 ! Output variables !
3212 ! ---------------- !
3213
3214 logical, intent(out) :: belongcv(pcols,pver+1) ! True if interface is in a CL ( either internal or external )
3215 real(r8), intent(out) :: ricl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Mean Richardson number of internal CL
3216 real(r8), intent(out) :: ghcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Half of normalized buoyancy production of internal CL
3217 real(r8), intent(out) :: shcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Galperin instability function of heat-moisture of internal CL
3218 real(r8), intent(out) :: smcl(pcols,ncvmax) ! Galperin instability function of momentum of internal CL
3219 real(r8), intent(out) :: lbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Thickness of (energetically) internal CL ( lint, [m] )
3220 real(r8), intent(out) :: wbrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Mean normalized TKE of internal CL [ m2/s2 ]
3221 real(r8), intent(out) :: ebrk(pcols,ncvmax) ! Mean TKE of internal CL ( b1*wbrk, [m2/s2] )
3222
3223 ! ------------------ !
3224 ! Internal variables !
3225 ! ------------------ !
3226
3227 logical :: extend ! True when CL is extended in zisocl
3228 logical :: extend_up ! True when CL is extended upward in zisocl
3229 logical :: extend_dn ! True when CL is extended downward in zisocl
3230 logical :: bottom ! True when CL base is at surface ( kb = pver + 1 )
3231
3232 integer :: i ! Local index for the longitude
3233 integer :: ncv ! CL Index increasing with height
3234 integer :: incv
3235 integer :: k
3236 integer :: kb ! Local index for kbase
3237 integer :: kt ! Local index for ktop
3238 integer :: ncvinit ! Value of ncv at routine entrance
3239 integer :: cntu ! Number of merged CLs during upward extension of individual CL
3240 integer :: cntd ! Number of merged CLs during downward extension of individual CL
3241 integer :: kbinc ! Index for incorporating underlying CL
3242 integer :: ktinc ! Index for incorporating overlying CL
3243
3244 real(r8) :: wint ! Normalized TKE of internal CL
3245 real(r8) :: dwinc ! Normalized TKE of CL external interfaces
3246 real(r8) :: dw_surf ! Normalized TKE of surface interfacial layer
3247 real(r8) :: dzinc
3248 real(r8) :: gh
3249 real(r8) :: sh
3250 real(r8) :: sm
3251 real(r8) :: gh_surf ! Half of normalized buoyancy production in surface interfacial layer
3252 real(r8) :: sh_surf ! Galperin instability function in surface interfacial layer
3253 real(r8) :: sm_surf ! Galperin instability function in surface interfacial layer
3254 real(r8) :: l2n2 ! Vertical integral of 'l^2N^2' over CL. Include thickness product
3255 real(r8) :: l2s2 ! Vertical integral of 'l^2S^2' over CL. Include thickness product
3256 real(r8) :: dl2n2 ! Vertical integration of 'l^2*N^2' of CL external interfaces
3257 real(r8) :: dl2s2 ! Vertical integration of 'l^2*S^2' of CL external interfaces

3259 real(r8) :: dl2s2_surf ! 'dl2s2' defined in the surface interfacial layer
3260 real(r8) :: lint ! Thickness of (energetically) internal CL
3261 real(r8) :: dlint ! Interfacial layer thickness of CL external interfaces
3262 real(r8) :: dlint_surf ! Surface interfacial layer thickness

3268 real(r8) :: trmc
3269 real(r8) :: det
3270 real(r8) :: zbot ! Height of CL base

3275 ! ----------------------- !
3276 ! Main Computation Begins !
3277 ! ----------------------- !
3278
3279 i = long
3280
3281 ! Initialize main output variables
3282
32838558187085581870 do k = 1, ncvmax
3284 ricl(i,k) = 0._r8
3285 ghcl(i,k) = 0._r8
3286 shcl(i,k) = 0._r8
3287 smcl(i,k) = 0._r8
3288 lbrk(i,k) = 0._r8
3289 wbrk(i,k) = 0._r8

329228527292852729 extend = .false.
3293 extend_up = .false.
3294 extend_dn = .false.

3296 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
3297 ! Loop over each CL to see if any of them need to be extended !
3298 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
3299
3300 ncv = 1
3301
330233460526198781 do while( ncv .le. ncvfin(i) )
3303
330433460523346052 ncvinit = ncv
3305 cntu = 0
3306 cntd = 0
3307 kb = kbase(i,ncv)
3308 kt = ktop(i,ncv)
3309
3310 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3311 ! Calculation of CL interior energetics including surface before extension !
3312 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3313 ! Note that the contribution of interior interfaces (not surface) to 'wint' is !
3314 ! accounted by using '-sh*l2n2 + sm*l2s2' while the contribution of surface is !
3315 ! accounted by using 'dwsurf = tkes/b1' when bflxs > 0. This approach is fully !
3316 ! reasonable. Another possible alternative, which seems to be also consistent !
3317 ! is to calculate 'dl2n2_surf' and 'dl2s2_surf' of surface interfacial layer !
3318 ! separately, and this contribution is explicitly added by initializing 'l2n2' !
3319 ! 'l2s2' not by zero, but by 'dl2n2_surf' and 'ds2n2_surf' below. At the same !
3320 ! time, 'dwsurf' should be excluded in 'wint' calculation below. The only diff.!
3321 ! between two approaches is that in case of the latter approach, contributions !
3322 ! of surface interfacial layer to the CL mean stability function (ri,gh,sh,sm) !
3323 ! are explicitly included while the first approach is not. In this sense, the !
3324 ! second approach seems to be more conceptually consistent, but currently, I !
3325 ! (Sungsu) will keep the first default approach. There is a switch !
3326 ! 'use_dw_surf' at the first part of eddy_diff.F90 chosing one of !
3327 ! these two options. !
3328 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3329
3330 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3331 ! Step 0: Calculate surface interfacial layer energetics !
3332 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3333
3334 lbulk = zi(i,kt) - zi(i,kb)
3335 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
3336 dlint_surf = 0._r8
3337 dl2n2_surf = 0._r8
3338 dl2s2_surf = 0._r8
3339 dw_surf = 0._r8
3340 if( kb .eq. pver+1 ) then
3341
334226461682646168 if( bflxs(i) .gt. 0._r8 ) then
3343
3344 ! Calculate stability functions of surface interfacial layer
3345 ! from the given 'bprod(i,pver+1)' and 'sprod(i,pver+1)' using
3346 ! inverse approach. Since alph5>0 and alph3<0, denominator of
3347 ! gg is always positive if bprod(i,pver+1)>0.
3348
334926253445250688 gg = 0.5_r8*vk*z(i,pver)*bprod(i,pver+1)/(tkes(i)**(3._r8/2._r8))
3350 gh = gg/(alph5-gg*alph3)
3351 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
3352 gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
3353 sh = alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh)
3354 sm = (alph1 + alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4*gh)
3355 ricll = min(-(sm/sh)*(bprod(i,pver+1)/sprod(i,pver+1)),ricrit)
3356
3357 ! Calculate surface interfacial layer contribution to CL internal
3358 ! energetics. By construction, 'dw_surf = -dl2n2_surf + ds2n2_surf'
3359 ! is exactly satisfied, which corresponds to assuming turbulent
3360 ! length scale of surface interfacial layer = vk * z(i,pver). Note
3361 ! 'dl2n2_surf','dl2s2_surf','dw_surf' include thickness product.
3362
3363 dlint_surf = z(i,pver)
336426253442625344 dl2n2_surf = -vk*(z(i,pver)**2)*bprod(i,pver+1)/(sh*sqrt(tkes(i)))
336526253442625344 dl2s2_surf = vk*(z(i,pver)**2)*sprod(i,pver+1)/(sm*sqrt(tkes(i)))
3366 dw_surf = (tkes(i)/b1)*z(i,pver)
3367
3368 else
3369
3370 ! Note that this case can happen when surface is an external
3371 ! interface of CL.
33722082420824 lbulk = zi(i,kt) - z(i,pver)
3373 lbulk = min( lbulk, lbulk_max )
3374
3375 end if
3376
3377 end if
3378
3379 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3380 ! Step 1: Include surface interfacial layer contribution !
3381 ! ------------------------------------------------------ !
3382
338333460523346052 lint = dlint_surf
3384 l2n2 = dl2n2_surf
3385 l2s2 = dl2s2_surf
3386 wint = dw_surf
3387 if( use_dw_surf ) then
338833460523346052 l2n2 = 0._r8
3389 l2s2 = 0._r8
3390 else
3391 wint = 0._r8
3392 end if
3393
3394 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3395 ! Step 2. Include the contribution of 'pure internal interfaces' other than surface !
3396 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
3397
339833460523346052 if( kt .lt. kb - 1 ) then ! The case of non-SBCL.
3399
340058726488487491 do k = kb - 1, kt + 1, -1
340158726485872648 if( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampcl' ) then
3402 ! Modification : I simply used the average tunlramp between the two limits.
340358726485872648 tunlramp = 0.5_r8*(1._r8+ctunl)*tunl
340400 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then
340500 tunlramp = ctunl*tunl
3406 ! tunlramp = 0.765_r8
3407 else
340800 tunlramp = tunl
3409 endif
341058726485872648 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then
3411587264823490592 lz = ( (vk*zi(i,k))**(-cleng) + (tunlramp*lbulk)**(-cleng) )**(-1._r8/cleng)
3412 ! lz = vk*zi(i,k) / (1._r8+vk*zi(i,k)/(tunlramp*lbulk))
3413 else
341400 lz = min( vk*zi(i,k), tunlramp*lbulk )
3415 endif
3416 lz = min(leng_max(k), lz)
3417 dzinc = z(i,k-1) - z(i,k)
3418 l2n2 = l2n2 + lz*lz*n2(i,k)*dzinc
3419 l2s2 = l2s2 + lz*lz*s2(i,k)*dzinc
3420 lint = lint + dzinc
3421 end do
3422
3423 ! Calculate initial CL stability functions (gh,sh,sm) and net
3424 ! internal energy of CL including surface contribution if any.
3425
3426 ! Modification : It seems that below cannot be applied when ricrit > 0.19.
3427 ! May need future generalization.
3428
342926148432614843 ricll = min(l2n2/max(l2s2,ntzero),ricrit) ! Mean Ri of internal CL
3430 trma = alph3*alph4*ricll+2._r8*b1*(alph2-alph4*alph5*ricll)
3431 trmb = ricll*(alph3+alph4)+2._r8*b1*(-alph5*ricll+alph1)
3432 trmc = ricll
3433 det = max(trmb*trmb-4._r8*trma*trmc,0._r8)
343426148432614843 gh = (-trmb + sqrt(det))/2._r8/trma
3435 ! gh = min(max(gh,-0.28_r8),0.0233_r8)
3436 gh = min(max(gh,-3.5334_r8),0.0233_r8)
3437 sh = alph5/(1._r8+alph3*gh)
3438 sm = (alph1 + alph2*gh)/(1._r8+alph3*gh)/(1._r8+alph4*gh)
3439 wint = wint - sh*l2n2 + sm*l2s2
3440
3441 else ! The case of SBCL
3442
3443 ! If there is no pure internal interface, use only surface interfacial
3444 ! values. However, re-set surface interfacial values such that it can
3445 ! be used in the merging tests (either based on 'wint' or 'l2n2') and
3446 ! in such that surface interfacial energy is not double-counted.
3447 ! Note that regardless of the choise of 'use_dw_surf', below should be
3448 ! kept as it is below, for consistent merging test of extending SBCL.
3449
3450731209731209 lint = dlint_surf
3451 l2n2 = dl2n2_surf
3452 l2s2 = dl2s2_surf
3453 wint = dw_surf
3454
3455 ! Aug.29.2006 : Only for the purpose of merging test of extending SRCL
3456 ! based on 'l2n2', re-define 'l2n2' of surface interfacial layer using
3457 ! 'wint'. This part is designed for similar treatment of merging as in
3458 ! the original 'eddy_diff.F90' code, where 'l2n2' of SBCL was defined
3459 ! as 'l2n2 = - wint / sh'. Note that below block is used only when (1)
3460 ! surface buoyancy production 'bprod(i,pver+1)' is NOT included in the
3461 ! calculation of surface TKE in the initialization of 'bprod(i,pver+1)'

3463 ! current scheme be similar to the previous scheme in the treatment of

3468731209731209 if( choice_tkes .eq. 'ebprod' ) then
346900 l2n2 = - wint / sh
3470 endif
3471
3472 endif

347733460523346052 l2n2 = -min(-l2n2, tkemax*lint/(b1*sh))
3478 l2s2 = min( l2s2, tkemax*lint/(b1*sm))
3479
3480 ! Note that at this stage, ( gh, sh, sm ) are the values of surface

3486 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !

3489 ! During the merging process, we assumed ( lbulk, sh, sm ) of CL external !

3496 ! Downward CL merging process is identical to the upward merging process, !

3499 ! carefully depending on the sign of surface buoyancy flux. The contribu !

3501 ! energetics of merging CL only when bflxs > 0. !

351333460523346052 tunlramp = 0.5_r8*(1._r8+ctunl)*tunl
351400 elseif( choice_tunl .eq. 'rampsl' ) then

352033460523346052 if( choice_leng .eq. 'origin' ) then

352633460523346052 lz = min(leng_max(kt), lz)
3527

3531 dwinc = -sh*dl2n2 + sm*dl2s2

3550 ! do while ( -dl2n2 .gt. (-rinc*dzinc*l2n2/(lint+(1._r8-rinc)*dzinc)) ) ! Merging test based on l2n2
355133460523557254 do while ( -dl2n2 .gt. (-rinc*l2n2/(1._r8-rinc)) & ! Integral merging test
355200 .and. (kt > ntop_turb+2 .or. z(i,kt) < 50000._r8) )

36191469414694 kt = ktop(i,ncv+cntu+1)

3735

401868748296874829 real(r8) function compute_cubic(a,b,c)
4019 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4020 ! Solve canonical cubic : x^3 + a*x^2 + b*x + c = 0, x = sqrt(e)/sqrt(<e>) !
4021 ! Set x = max(xmin,x) at the end !
4022 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4023 implicit none
4024 real(r8), intent(in) :: a, b, c
4025 real(r8) qq, rr, dd, theta, aa, bb, x1, x2, x3
4026 real(r8), parameter :: xmin = 1.e-2_r8
4027
402868748296874829 qq = (a**2-3._r8*b)/9._r8
402968748296874829 rr = (2._r8*a**3 - 9._r8*a*b + 27._r8*c)/54._r8
4030
403168748296874829 dd = rr**2 - qq**3
4032 if( dd .le. 0._r8 ) then
4033521522115645663 theta = acos(rr/qq**(3._r8/2._r8))
4034521522110430442 x1 = -2._r8*sqrt(qq)*cos(theta/3._r8) - a/3._r8
4035521522110430442 x2 = -2._r8*sqrt(qq)*cos((theta+2._r8*3.141592_r8)/3._r8) - a/3._r8
4036521522110430442 x3 = -2._r8*sqrt(qq)*cos((theta-2._r8*3.141592_r8)/3._r8) - a/3._r8
4037 compute_cubic = max(max(max(x1,x2),x3),xmin)
4038 return
4039 else
404016596081659608 if( rr .ge. 0._r8 ) then
4041129212646060 aa = -(sqrt(rr**2-qq**3)+rr)**(1._r8/3._r8)
4042 else
404315303967651980 aa = (sqrt(rr**2-qq**3)-rr)**(1._r8/3._r8)
4044 endif
404516596081659608 if( aa .eq. 0._r8 ) then
404600 bb = 0._r8
4047 else
404816596081659608 bb = qq/aa
4049 endif
405016596081659608 compute_cubic = max((aa+bb)-a/3._r8,xmin)
4051 return
4052 endif
4053
4054 return
405568748296874829 end function compute_cubic
